Furnace Knuckle.name: Furnace Knuckle
Furnace Knuckle.description: Drive a close punch with a tightly contained fire release at contact. Resolve one Force Combat attack with its bonus; the heat is part of that single hit, not an additional automatic attack or area explosion. Costs 6 Mana when the infusion is committed, including a miss. This named exertion also costs 4 Stamina on commitment.

Gravitic Drive.name: Gravitic Drive
Gravitic Drive.description: Commit to a heavy physical strike with a brief directed gravity pull reinforcing its impact. Resolve one Force Combat attack with its bonus; any displacement follows the actual result and does not guarantee a knockdown or create a remote crushing field. Costs 6 Mana when committed. This named exertion also costs 4 Stamina on commitment.

Needleflash.name: Needleflash
Needleflash.description: Place a precise close weapon or unarmed strike carrying a narrow lightning discharge. Resolve one Finesse Combat attack with its bonus. The discharge belongs to that hit and grants no second attack, guaranteed stun, teleportation, or additional turn. Costs 6 Mana when committed. This named exertion also costs 4 Stamina on commitment.

Rime Feint.name: Rime Feint
Rime Feint.description: Shape a small false edge of frost along a trained close attack, then change its physical line. Resolve one Finesse Combat attack with its bonus; the ice assists the feint without a detached projectile, free follow-up, or automatic freezing. Costs 6 Mana when committed. This named exertion also costs 4 Stamina on commitment.

Rooted Guard.name: Rooted Guard
Rooted Guard.description: Brace a trained guarded stance with short-lived roots connected to nearby viable ground. Resolve one Guarded Combat action to resist displacement or hold the stated position, using its bonus. It grants no automatic counterattack, invulnerability, or permanent terrain. Costs 6 Mana; unsuitable ground prevents the root support. This named exertion also costs 4 Stamina on commitment.

Current Brace.name: Current Brace
Current Brace.description: Guide a small controlled current across a braced guard to divert pressure during one contested exchange. Resolve one Guarded Combat action with its bonus. It provides no remote attack, automatic hit cancellation, breathing supply, or lingering universal shield. Costs 6 Mana when committed. This named exertion also costs 4 Stamina on commitment.

Arcane Stitch.name: Arcane Stitch
Arcane Stitch.description: Shape a narrow force tether to catch a reachable loose object or attempt a brief restraint against one target. Resolve one Arcane Magic check with its bonus. Resistance, line of effect, available anchoring and the actual result limit the tether; it is not an unavoidable capture. Costs 6 Mana.

Current Lash.name: Current Lash
Current Lash.description: Direct a narrow lash of water at one visible target within the caster's practiced reach. Resolve one Water Magic attack with its bonus; this is a detached spell governed by Passion even when delivered through a staff or sword. Costs 6 Mana, with no automatic second hit or guaranteed knockdown.

Gentle Closure.name: Gentle Closure
Gentle Closure.description: Treat one reachable living person's fresh injury with a basic restorative working. Resolve one Healing Magic check with its bonus; on success restore the basic healing band in resourceSettings once, unless the supplied result specifies otherwise. Costs 6 Mana. It does not reverse age, lasting injury or death.

Borrowed Outline.name: Borrowed Outline
Borrowed Outline.description: Project one simple visual decoy near the caster for the current exchange. Resolve one Illusion Magic check with its bonus against relevant observation. The decoy has no substance, attack or independent action, and scrutiny can reveal it. Costs 6 Mana; further maintenance needs an established cost.

Mana Knock.name: Mana Knock
Mana Knock.description: Stamp a compact rune of force into the air and send it into one visible point within 6 metres. The impact can strike a creature or knock a small loose object along the chosen line. A successful forceful hit may spoil footing; the result determines how much the target actually yields. A short, economical release suited to close fighting and practical interference. Costs 3 Mana on commitment, including a committed miss.

Halfmoon Pane.name: Halfmoon Pane
Halfmoon Pane.description: Unfold a curved, translucent pane about an arm’s length across within 2 metres. Angle it against one declared incoming line, or use it as momentary cover for a nearby person. It lasts for the current exchange; pressure cracks and turns its bright edge before breaking it. Its small surface rewards choosing the right angle rather than enclosing the whole group. Costs 4 Mana on commitment, including a committed miss.

Glasshand Cradle.name: Glasshand Cradle
Glasshand Cradle.description: Shape two cupped force surfaces around one loose object weighing up to roughly 3 kilograms within 5 metres. Carry, turn or steady it with the care of an extra pair of hands while you concentrate, for up to a minute outside combat or two exchanges in danger. Fine handling is possible at a deliberate pace; a held object or resisting creature needs a contested method rather than this unattended-object working. Costs 3 Mana on commitment, including a committed miss.

Prism Javelin.name: Prism Javelin
Prism Javelin.description: Draw a long faceted spear of compressed mana along your forearm, then release it down a clear line at one visible target within 15 metres. The narrow profile concentrates the impact at one point and suits exposed gaps or small targets. The facets are force geometry, not a Light spell. Cover, aim and the actual attack result still decide what it strikes. Costs 6 Mana on commitment, including a committed miss.

Borrowed Stair.name: Borrowed Stair
Borrowed Stair.description: Set up to three broad force footholds along a route you can see within 8 metres. They support one person at a time for a short crossing, up to a minute or two combat exchanges while you maintain them. Their spacing can bridge a gap, reach a ledge or give a stranded ally a way down. Establish the actual route and footing; the steps are temporary supports, not flight or a jump between locations. Costs 8 Mana on commitment, including a committed miss.

Rebound Seal.name: Rebound Seal
Rebound Seal.description: Place a slanted seal in the path of one visible, tangible incoming projectile within 6 metres. On a successful interception, the seal kicks it toward an unoccupied line or harmless surface you can identify. Redirecting a shot is the whole action: sending it into another creature would require its own supported attack, and a sustained beam or broad wave cannot be caught as one little missile. Costs 8 Mana on commitment, including a committed miss.

Counterweight Cuff.name: Counterweight Cuff
Counterweight Cuff.description: Fasten a broad force cuff around a willing person or reachable load, then tether it to an actual stable support within 8 metres. The tether can arrest a short fall, steady a hanging burden or share the strain of moving something heavy for two exchanges. Support strength and the real load matter. The working transmits force along a tether; it does not change the object’s weight or levitate an untethered burden. Costs 8 Mana on commitment, including a committed miss.

Lattice Snare.name: Lattice Snare
Lattice Snare.description: Stretch a visible lattice of force across a chosen opening up to 3 metres wide within 10 metres. Set its catches to obstruct a particular route for two exchanges. A creature that presses through must contend with the threads or find an actual way around; bracing points and the opposing result determine whether it is checked, entangled or breaks the web. The bright pattern warns an attentive foe where the danger lies. Costs 12 Mana on commitment, including a committed miss.

Hollow Knight.name: Hollow Knight
Hollow Knight.description: Raise a human-sized, hollow knight-shaped frame of force within 6 metres and direct it for up to three exchanges while concentrating. It can brace one opening, carry a nearby burden within its supported strength, or deliver one directed blow as your action. It is a controlled spell structure with no independent turn, personality or summoned person. Losing control collapses the empty plates into sparks. Costs 14 Mana on commitment, including a committed miss.

Orbit of Needles.name: Orbit of Needles
Orbit of Needles.description: Gather three bright force needles into a tight orbit around your casting hand, then commit them along converging curves at one target within 12 metres. Choose the approach before release: a wide split can threaten the sides of a guard, while a close helix concentrates its pressure. Resolve the committed volley as one attack with this bonus, not three automatic hits or three separate full damage awards. Solid cover can still intercept the chosen curves. Costs 14 Mana on commitment, including a committed miss.

Hammerfall Diagram.name: Hammerfall Diagram
Hammerfall Diagram.description: Sketch a broad descending sigil over a visible patch of ground within 15 metres. After a clear downward sweep of your hand, compressed force crashes through a circle roughly 3 metres across. The forming diagram and your gesture telegraph the strike; fast opponents can contest or leave its reach. Resolve the creatures actually caught by the area through their supplied outcomes, rather than assigning every nearby body an automatic hit. Costs 24 Mana on commitment, including a committed miss.

Glassless Citadel.name: Glassless Citadel
Glassless Citadel.description: Plant three linked force panels around a chosen position within 8 metres, enclosing at most a small cluster of people behind waist-to-head-high cover for three exchanges. Doors, gaps and panel angles are selected when you set it. Concentrated pressure can break a panel, and enemies can use real routes over or around the arrangement. It is stationary shelter whose strength lies in its layout, not a moving bubble of invulnerability. Costs 30 Mana on commitment, including a committed miss.

Twelvefold Procession.name: Twelvefold Procession
Twelvefold Procession.description: Assemble four elegant force frames, each with three luminous joints, in a cluster within 10 metres. For three exchanges of concentration, direct one purposeful operation each turn: lift a beam together, carry someone clear, brace a failing structure or commit their coordinated strength to one strike. The twelve joints share your attention and action; they do not create four summoned allies or four independent attacks. Broken supports and heavy loads remain real problems to resolve. Costs 30 Mana on commitment, including a committed miss.

Pressure Psalm.name: Pressure Psalm
Pressure Psalm.description: Release a rolling procession of compressed force along a corridor or open lane up to 20 metres long and 3 metres wide. Its visible pulses press exposed targets toward a chosen end of that lane, with the actual attack and resistance deciding injury and displacement. Heavy anchors, side cover and openings disrupt the pressure. The measured rhythm is force control, not Sound casting; there is one committed area working rather than a fresh full hit for every pulse. Costs 40 Mana on commitment, including a committed miss.

Severance Diagram.name: Severance Diagram
Severance Diagram.description: Lay an exact force diagram against one visible physical barrier, support or force construct within 12 metres, then drive its pressure into a chosen joint. The technique concentrates a breach at that point so allies can exploit a real opening. Material strength, reinforcement and the opposing working determine success. It attacks a structure through force and precision rather than universally dispelling magic or deleting every obstacle on a route. Costs 40 Mana on commitment, including a committed miss.

Aegis of the Last Bell.name: Aegis of the Last Bell
Aegis of the Last Bell.description: Ring a great silent arc of runes around yourself and up to three nearby allies within 4 metres. For the current exchange, its inward-curving surfaces meet one declared direction of assault and spread the pressure across the formation. It is a demanding chance to weather a major attack or make a withdrawal possible; the actual contest can still crack it. Attacks from an unguarded direction, enemies already inside the line and unsupported consequences are not erased. Costs 55 Mana on commitment, including a committed miss.

Quiet Meridian.name: Quiet Meridian
Quiet Meridian.description: Settle into a deliberate, uninterrupted recovery action and draw a small additional flow from the ambient mana. On a genuinely completed working, recover exactly 5 Mana once, capped by your actual maximum. This is an explicit recovery technique; ordinary turns restore no Mana. It cannot be combined with attacking, another spell, demanding exertion or active hostile interference during that exchange; interruption loses the recovery. Costs 0 Mana and 0 Stamina. Its ten-turn recovery interval also applies to cosmetic restatements of this same working.

Doorholder.name: Doorholder
Doorholder.description: Set your trained guard across one narrow approach within your physical reach, using the actual weapon, shield, body position and terrain available. Contest someone trying to force that line during the current exchange; a successful hold checks their entry or makes them choose a real route around you. This is a deliberate positional action. An ordinary guard remains possible without spending Stamina, but does not receive this technique’s bonus. Costs 4 Stamina on commitment, including a committed miss.

Measured Reprisal.name: Measured Reprisal
Measured Reprisal.description: Answer a nearby opponent’s observed overextension with one compact guarded strike. Keep your line closed as you attack the opening their actual movement left. Use a trained weapon or unarmed method within its real reach. It is your committed attack, not a free reaction added to somebody else’s turn; without a genuine opening, choose a different action. Costs 4 Stamina on commitment, including a committed miss.

Iron Hinge.name: Iron Hinge
Iron Hinge.description: Turn a shield or suitably braced weapon around a tight pivot to shed one reachable close strike away from your center. Choose where the force can safely go and contest the actual attack. A successful turn can preserve your position and expose its committed line, but it supplies no automatic follow-up hit. You need the real equipment and room for the pivot. Costs 6 Stamina on commitment, including a committed miss.

Crossbar Catch.name: Crossbar Catch
Crossbar Catch.description: Trap a reachable weapon momentarily between your trained guard and an actual shield rim, weapon crosspiece or safe bracing surface. Contest control of that line for the current exchange, buying an opening to disengage or change position. The opponent can contest or release their weapon. Reach, leverage and an available catching surface matter; the catch is not a disarm against every weapon. Costs 6 Stamina on commitment, including a committed miss.

Shoulder Lantern.name: Shoulder Lantern
Shoulder Lantern.description: Bring one reachable willing ally, or someone who can actually be supported, behind your physical cover and guide them a few paces toward a chosen safe position. Keep your guard between them and one visible threat. Resolve the actual movement, burden and interception; the technique does not teleport the ally or negate a hit already resolved. The lantern is the sheltering role, not a magical light. Costs 8 Stamina on commitment, including a committed miss.

Low Roof Advance.name: Low Roof Advance
Low Roof Advance.description: Advance a short distance under a compact shield, braced weapon guard or actual overhead cover, keeping one identified projectile lane screened. Stay low and commit to the route instead of sprinting blindly into it. The move contests that approach while carrying you toward the next piece of cover; flanking angles, unsupported protection and an open field remain dangerous. Costs 8 Stamina on commitment, including a committed miss.

Breakwater Turn.name: Breakwater Turn
Breakwater Turn.description: Meet a close opponent’s committed pressure, turn your braced guard and guide the exchange toward an open side you can actually occupy. On a successful contest, use their momentum to change the line or move them off the immediate approach. It is one physical defensive maneuver; the result decides displacement, and an anchored foe may refuse the turn. No Water casting or automatic knockdown is involved. Costs 10 Stamina on commitment, including a committed miss.

Shelter Behind Me.name: Shelter Behind Me
Shelter Behind Me.description: Build a tight protective formation with up to two allies who can stay close behind your actual reach and equipment. Spend the current exchange covering one declared approach and contest an interception that would expose them. You give ground, brace or take the pressure as the resolved situation requires. Allies can act normally, but your formation is not an all-round shield and gives you no automatic defense roll against every attack in the room. Costs 14 Stamina on commitment, including a committed miss.

Cinder Snap.name: Cinder Snap
Cinder Snap.description: Flick a compact flame into one visible target within 8 metres. Its sharp contact can ignite exposed dry tinder or sting an unprotected opening; fuel and the resolved hit determine what keeps burning. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Hearthkeeper's Palm.name: Hearthkeeper's Palm
Hearthkeeper's Palm.description: Cup a small controlled flame above your hand for a minute, warming food, lighting a wick or starting a prepared fire. It stays near your hand and offers no general protection from other flames. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Ember Ribbon.name: Ember Ribbon
Ember Ribbon.description: Draw a low burning ribbon across a two-metre line within reach. It discourages a close approach for one exchange, with a clear edge an attentive opponent can avoid or contest. Costs 5 Mana on commitment.

Coalglass Veil.name: Coalglass Veil
Coalglass Veil.description: Sweep a curtain of ember-lit hot air across one incoming line within 3 metres. It can spoil light projectiles and vision for the exchange; it is a heat screen, not a solid wall. Costs 5 Mana on commitment.

Sootmark Dart.name: Sootmark Dart
Sootmark Dart.description: Send a small hot dart toward one target within 15 metres. On contact it leaves a visible soot mark useful for tracking that target through smoke or a crowd, without revealing someone behind solid cover. Costs 6 Mana on commitment.

Cinder Hook.name: Cinder Hook
Cinder Hook.description: Bend a flame release around one practiced corner toward a point you can still perceive within 12 metres. Choose the curve before release; unseen targets and intervening barriers remain uncertain. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Bellows Bloom.name: Bellows Bloom
Bellows Bloom.description: Expand a hand-sized flame into a brief cone up to 5 metres long. It pressures a clustered approach, with actual targets resolving the burst rather than receiving repeated automatic hits. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Kiln Shepherd.name: Kiln Shepherd
Kiln Shepherd.description: Guide an existing fire along a chosen fuel path or pull its heat away from one nearby working surface. The displaced heat needs somewhere to go; this is controlled fire management, not free Ice shaping. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Red Thread Detonation.name: Red Thread Detonation
Red Thread Detonation.description: Lay a visible glowing thread up to 4 metres across a real surface, then release its stored burst as your action before the next exchange ends. A disturbed or broken thread can spoil the planned line. Costs 12 Mana on commitment.

Furnace Halo.name: Furnace Halo
Furnace Halo.description: Hold a low ring of rotating flame within 2 metres for two exchanges. It makes a close rush costly to contest while leaving you responsible for allies and exposed fuel inside its reach. Costs 14 Mana on commitment.

Heat Thief's Mantle.name: Heat Thief's Mantle
Heat Thief's Mantle.description: Draw heat from one reachable object into a visible hot mantle around your focus, then discharge it into a safe surface. The transfer can cool tools or weaken a small fire; it is limited by heat load and control. Costs 12 Mana on commitment.

Salamander Gallery.name: Salamander Gallery
Salamander Gallery.description: Send three animal-shaped streams of fire along chosen paths across a small visible area. They are guided spell forms, not summoned creatures, and their coordinated release is one area working. Costs 24 Mana on commitment.

White Coal Lance.name: White Coal Lance
White Coal Lance.description: Compress a bright hot lance along a straight firing line up to 25 metres. A deliberate charge makes it useful against a particular hard point while warning anyone who can see the gathering heat. Costs 28 Mana on commitment.

Scorched Ballroom.name: Scorched Ballroom
Scorched Ballroom.description: Mark several visible safe lanes through a broad flame field roughly 6 metres across. You must maintain its arrangement for two exchanges; broken concentration and moving allies make precise exclusion difficult. Costs 30 Mana on commitment.

Furnace Without Walls.name: Furnace Without Walls
Furnace Without Walls.description: Raise the heat of a chosen open volume around an existing blaze, forcing opponents to choose between cover and escape. Actual ventilation, materials and targets constrain this sustained two-exchange pressure. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

Red Sun Funeral.name: Red Sun Funeral
Red Sun Funeral.description: Gather a brilliant sphere and burst it over a visible patch within 30 metres, engulfing roughly a five-metre circle. The long gathering motion is obvious, and the resolved area strike includes real collateral risk. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

Ashen Crown Procession.name: Ashen Crown Procession
Ashen Crown Procession.description: Advance a broad, carefully shaped front of flame through one declared lane for three exchanges. Each change of direction takes your attention; the procession cannot hunt remote enemies or spare unobserved bystanders automatically. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

The Last Hearth.name: The Last Hearth
The Last Hearth.description: Draw an approaching ordinary blaze away from a small group into a controlled, fiercely hot focus and discharge it to a chosen safe fuel bed. Great fires contest your control; this is a demanding rescue working, not immunity to every heat source. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

Tide Needle.name: Tide Needle
Tide Needle.description: Drive a finger-thin jet at one visible point within 8 metres. It can strike an exposed target or precisely wash debris from an object; pressure and the actual result govern damage. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Ripple Guard.name: Ripple Guard
Ripple Guard.description: Lift a curved sheet of water across one close approach for the current exchange. It redirects a modest incoming pressure rather than enclosing you or freezing into a solid shield. Costs 4 Mana on commitment.

Cupbearer's Orbit.name: Cupbearer's Orbit
Cupbearer's Orbit.description: Carry a small orbiting cup of water within 3 metres for a minute, turning and pouring it deliberately. Conjured water fades; lasting drink or washing supplies need an actual source. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Slipstream Patch.name: Slipstream Patch
Slipstream Patch.description: Send a shallow flow across a small visible patch of ground. Its direction can spoil a committed step or help a careful crossing; it does not guarantee that every creature falls. Costs 5 Mana on commitment.

Undertow Knot.name: Undertow Knot
Undertow Knot.description: Coil a moving current around a reachable object or ankle within 8 metres. The pull needs a real flow or maintained conjuration and is contested by footing and strength. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Raincatch Canopy.name: Raincatch Canopy
Raincatch Canopy.description: Hold a slanted water canopy over two nearby people for two exchanges. It catches rain, sparks and light falling debris while leaving sides exposed and carrying no air supply. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Riverglass Spear.name: Riverglass Spear
Riverglass Spear.description: Project a dense water spear along a straight line up to 18 metres. Concentrated pressure suits a narrow target; barriers and the resolved attack determine whether it penetrates. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Washline Passage.name: Washline Passage
Washline Passage.description: Drive a controlled channel through smoke, mud or loose debris along a short visible route. It clears a usable path without silently destroying a structure or purifying every contaminant. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Tidal Handshake.name: Tidal Handshake
Tidal Handshake.description: Join two nearby water flows and exchange their direction at a chosen crossing. It can turn a stream or interrupt a prepared water attack when the opposing working yields. Costs 12 Mana on commitment.

Foamstep Wake.name: Foamstep Wake
Foamstep Wake.description: Build a short moving swell beneath a willing swimmer or small floating load. Guide it toward a visible bank within 15 metres; rough water and actual weight remain relevant. Costs 12 Mana on commitment.

Floodgate Waltz.name: Floodgate Waltz
Floodgate Waltz.description: Raise and release a broad water gate across a five-metre passage. Its visible collapse pushes through the lane as one area action, with escape routes and sturdy anchors affecting the result. Costs 24 Mana on commitment.

Deep Current Harness.name: Deep Current Harness
Deep Current Harness.description: Use an actual pool or maintained water mass to support and move a substantial load for three exchanges. The harness transmits hydraulic force; it does not lighten the load or control blood. Costs 26 Mana on commitment.

Blue Bastion Wheel.name: Blue Bastion Wheel
Blue Bastion Wheel.description: Rotate a thick water screen around a small position for two exchanges. Concentrating its mass against one approach weakens another; an opponent can exploit that changing cover. Costs 30 Mana on commitment.

River Takes the Street.name: River Takes the Street
River Takes the Street.description: Redirect an existing large flow through a declared visible route. It can flood a defended lane or relieve a blocked channel, with real drainage, ownership and downstream consequences. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

Thousand-Drop Volley.name: Thousand-Drop Volley
Thousand-Drop Volley.description: Compress a large spray into a coordinated attack across a small visible zone. Resolve the targets actually caught once; the number of droplets does not multiply the damage award. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

Tidekeeper's Cathedral.name: Tidekeeper's Cathedral
Tidekeeper's Cathedral.description: Lift a major body of water into supporting arches and channels for three exchanges of full attention. It can shelter an evacuation or reshape a crossing, but needs water and stable real routes. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

Sea at the Door.name: Sea at the Door
Sea at the Door.description: Bring an enormous existing surge to a chosen boundary, splitting its force around a small defended position. This is a contest with the actual water mass, not a conjured ocean or control over distant weather. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

Pebble Hammer.name: Pebble Hammer
Pebble Hammer.description: Snap one small stone toward a visible target within 8 metres, or form a temporary stone if none is available. The committed impact is one attack, not an automatic armor break. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Dustwall Fold.name: Dustwall Fold
Dustwall Fold.description: Raise a low fold of earth or conjured grit against one close approach. It offers brief directional cover; the loose shape can be broken or moved around. Costs 4 Mana on commitment.

Sandfinger.name: Sandfinger
Sandfinger.description: Guide a handful of sand through a nearby crack or across a surface to reveal its shape. It is a careful physical probe, not sight through walls or automatic trap disarming. Costs 4 Mana on commitment.

Potter's Knuckle.name: Potter's Knuckle
Potter's Knuckle.description: Press and shape a small area of suitable clay or soil into a useful handle, brace or channel. Real material can remain changed; conjured stock is temporary. Costs 5 Mana on commitment.

Uneven Welcome.name: Uneven Welcome
Uneven Welcome.description: Lift one shallow ridge beneath a visible committed approach within 6 metres. The change can spoil footing when the actual movement meets it, without guaranteeing a fall. Costs 6 Mana on commitment.

Scree Fan.name: Scree Fan
Scree Fan.description: Scatter a controlled fan of gravel through a short cone. Its purpose is close pressure and a changed approach, with one resolved release rather than a full hit for each fragment. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Burrower's Ramp.name: Burrower's Ramp
Burrower's Ramp.description: Push up a short earthen ramp between visible levels a few metres apart. It needs suitable ground and an actual route; supporting an unsafe structure remains a separate problem. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Anchor Teeth.name: Anchor Teeth
Anchor Teeth.description: Set several blunt stone catches around a real object or planted position. They can resist dragging and support a contested hold for two exchanges, but do not imprison everything nearby. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Sandblind Curtain.name: Sandblind Curtain
Sandblind Curtain.description: Lift a localized moving curtain of sand across one line of sight. It obscures rather than edits perception; wind, cover and breathing conditions affect both sides. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Faultstep Line.name: Faultstep Line
Faultstep Line.description: Send a shallow moving buckle along a visible strip of ground up to 10 metres. Standing targets contest the disruption; flying enemies and deep foundations are not automatically struck. Costs 12 Mana on commitment.

Mason's Embrace.name: Mason's Embrace
Mason's Embrace.description: Close two low stone braces around a chosen gap, load or approach. Select a safe opening when forming them; the work does not crush a resisting body without an actual attack. Costs 14 Mana on commitment.

Quarry Bell.name: Quarry Bell
Quarry Bell.description: Drive a heavy earth pulse through one visible stone surface to fracture a selected weak point. Thickness and reinforcement matter; the technique does not survey an entire hidden tunnel system. Costs 24 Mana on commitment.

Dune Spiral.name: Dune Spiral
Dune Spiral.description: Circle a small area with a moving bank of sand for two exchanges. It controls sight and footing, leaving an observable center and routes that can be contested. Costs 26 Mana on commitment.

Granite Procession.name: Granite Procession
Granite Procession.description: Raise several sequential stone slabs along a planned route, creating cover or stepping structures. They share one directed working rather than becoming independent golems. Costs 30 Mana on commitment.

Mountain's Open Hand.name: Mountain's Open Hand
Mountain's Open Hand.description: Lift and reposition a major accessible slab or boulder through deliberate earth control. The caster must account for its supports, fall path and anyone beneath it. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

Buried Drum March.name: Buried Drum March
Buried Drum March.description: Send a powerful series of ground heaves through a limited visible field. Resolve the whole area working against actual footing and structures, not an unavoidable earthquake across the realm. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

Citadel From the Dust.name: Citadel From the Dust
Citadel From the Dust.description: Shape a substantial existing earthwork into a temporary defended layout with chosen ramps and openings. Construction takes sustained attention and appropriate ground; conjured material later fades. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

The Patient Mountain.name: The Patient Mountain
The Patient Mountain.description: Brace a threatened slope or collapsing earthen passage long enough for an evacuation. The actual mass can overwhelm the working, and holding it occupies the caster rather than granting a second attack. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

Gale Tap.name: Gale Tap
Gale Tap.description: Release a compact burst of air at one nearby target or loose object. It can strike or spoil a small movement within 8 metres, with the actual contest deciding displacement. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Sleevewind Guard.name: Sleevewind Guard
Sleevewind Guard.description: Curl a close current across one incoming line for the exchange. It can divert light material and soften a modest approach, without becoming an all-round wall. Costs 4 Mana on commitment.

Paperkite Errand.name: Paperkite Errand
Paperkite Errand.description: Carry a light note or object along a visible route within 15 metres. Guide it deliberately around ordinary obstacles; it is not a sentient courier or a message to an unknown distant office. Costs 4 Mana on commitment.

Bellows Breath.name: Bellows Breath
Bellows Breath.description: Drive fresh air through one nearby smoky or poorly ventilated space. It can clear a useful pocket, but does not guarantee breathable air in a vacuum or neutralize every poison. Costs 5 Mana on commitment.

Featherfall Catch.name: Featherfall Catch
Featherfall Catch.description: Apply a cushioning updraft beneath one visible falling person within 8 metres. A real timely interception can soften the landing; a fall already resolved is not undone. Costs 6 Mana on commitment.

Sickle Gust.name: Sickle Gust
Sickle Gust.description: Send a narrow curved pressure edge along a chosen line up to 12 metres. Its motion is visible in dust and cloth, and actual cover can break the line. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Windsail Traverse.name: Windsail Traverse
Windsail Traverse.description: Assist a jump or glide across a short visible gap with a timed current. This supports real movement and landing skill; it is not sustained flight at this training level. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Crosswind Stitch.name: Crosswind Stitch
Crosswind Stitch.description: Join two short currents to divert a projectile toward a safe line. A precise interception can change its path without automatically returning an attack on its shooter. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Cloudbrush.name: Cloudbrush
Cloudbrush.description: Work on an accessible low cloud or mist bank to open a small viewing channel or shift its edge. Actual weather and air mass limit the attempt. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Whistling Corridor.name: Whistling Corridor
Whistling Corridor.description: Maintain a directed air lane through a short passage for two exchanges. It can push loose smoke or resist a close approach; it does not grant Sound magic through its noise. Costs 12 Mana on commitment.

Updraft Saddle.name: Updraft Saddle
Updraft Saddle.description: Hold a brief lifting current beneath a willing person or small load near a real ledge. It steadies a crossing for two exchanges and needs attention, rather than becoming free flight. Costs 14 Mana on commitment.

Stormgate Fan.name: Stormgate Fan
Stormgate Fan.description: Throw a broad fan of pressure through a five-metre lane. The single area release can scatter an exposed formation, with weight, cover and actual resistance governing the effect. Costs 24 Mana on commitment.

Shearwall Pavilion.name: Shearwall Pavilion
Shearwall Pavilion.description: Maintain intersecting wind screens around a small position for two exchanges. Their direction matters: a protected line can leave a dangerous cross-draft or uncovered side. Costs 26 Mana on commitment.

Rainwright's Turn.name: Rainwright's Turn
Rainwright's Turn.description: Redirect a nearby rain-bearing cloud's local movement through sustained weather work. It can alter an immediate shower, not conjure a realm-wide storm or award Lightning proficiency. Costs 30 Mana on commitment.

Hurricane Loom.name: Hurricane Loom
Hurricane Loom.description: Weave a powerful rotating air field around a chosen visible center. It contests movement for two exchanges while leaving a clear outer edge and the real environment available for escape. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

Skyward Processional.name: Skyward Processional
Skyward Processional.description: Raise a controlled sequence of updrafts to carry a prepared group between nearby elevations. It requires a planned route and landing, with no automatic safety for unwilling or unready passengers. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

Wings Without Feathers.name: Wings Without Feathers
Wings Without Feathers.description: Sustain controlled personal flight for a short scene through continuous air support. Load, weather, attention and landing remain real concerns; leaving the scene's scale is a separate travel problem. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

The Storm Bows Aside.name: The Storm Bows Aside
The Storm Bows Aside.description: Hold a major local wind front away from a chosen small evacuation lane. The caster contests actual weather and spends full attention on the refuge rather than commanding every storm in the region. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

Needle Spark.name: Needle Spark
Needle Spark.description: Snap a narrow spark toward one exposed point within 6 metres. It gives a sharp electrical sting or trips a suitably delicate unprotected contact; metal armour does not automatically turn this into a lethal hit. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Static Hem.name: Static Hem
Static Hem.description: Charge the edge of a sleeve or held cloth for one exchange. Its crackling fringe warns of close contact and can spoil a reaching hand when contact is actually made. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Forked Pin.name: Forked Pin
Forked Pin.description: Release a short fork of lightning toward one target within 12 metres. Choose two possible contact points on that target before release; this remains one attack rather than two full strikes. Costs 5 Mana on commitment.

Stormchalk.name: Stormchalk
Stormchalk.description: Trace a faintly sparking mark across a nearby dry surface. For a minute it reveals whether a small conductive object touches the line; it needs watching and does not report identities or remote events. Costs 4 Mana on commitment.

Jolting Recall.name: Jolting Recall
Jolting Recall.description: Pull a small conductive object toward your open hand across up to 3 metres using a brief electrical tug. A secured object or resisting holder contests the attempt; electricity does not make every material magnetic. Costs 6 Mana on commitment.

Crackle Net.name: Crackle Net
Crackle Net.description: Throw a loose electrical mesh across a two-metre opening within 10 metres. For one exchange it threatens anyone crossing it; insulation, cover and breaking the mesh offer practical answers. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Thunderrail.name: Thunderrail
Thunderrail.description: Drive one discharge along an existing conductive rail, chain or cable whose path you have checked. Its endpoint must be within 20 metres and the connected metal makes unsafe handling dangerous to allies too. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Nervebreak Flash.name: Nervebreak Flash
Nervebreak Flash.description: Concentrate a brief discharge on an exposed limb within 8 metres. A successful contact can disrupt one movement; anatomy, insulation and resistance determine the effect rather than guaranteeing paralysis. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Stormglass Lance.name: Stormglass Lance
Stormglass Lance.description: Compress a bright spear of lightning and hurl it toward one visible target within 25 metres. The release is straight and loud, with strong piercing pressure along its single resolved line. Costs 12 Mana on commitment.

Grounding Spiral.name: Grounding Spiral
Grounding Spiral.description: Route a nearby electrical surge through a conductive path into suitable earth. This protects a small working space when the route can bear the load; it neither grounds every attack nor recharges personal Mana. Costs 12 Mana on commitment.

Chain of Brass Bells.name: Chain of Brass Bells
Chain of Brass Bells.description: Send a discharge between up to three close conductive targets within 15 metres. Each next gap must be under 2 metres, and the divided burst resolves as one attack across its actual exposed recipients. Costs 16 Mana on commitment.

Stormhook Descent.name: Stormhook Descent
Stormhook Descent.description: Anchor an electrical arc overhead and pull its striking point down through one visible lane within 20 metres. The bright anchor warns people before the strike and can be disrupted during its setup. Costs 24 Mana on commitment.

Blue Hour Cage.name: Blue Hour Cage
Blue Hour Cage.description: Suspend a crackling cage around a three-metre space within 12 metres for two exchanges. Its gaps and grounding points remain visible; crossing or breaking a segment contests that segment rather than causing endless automatic damage. Costs 28 Mana on commitment.

Thunderhead Loom.name: Thunderhead Loom
Thunderhead Loom.description: Gather a small storm cloud over an outdoor space with suitable moisture, spending an exchange to shape it. On your following action discharge one broad bolt within 30 metres; losing concentration disperses the prepared cloud. Costs 30 Mana on commitment.

Sky Nail Volley.name: Sky Nail Volley
Sky Nail Volley.description: Plant several brilliant points over a visible battlefield and release a coordinated burst along chosen lanes within 40 metres. Declare the lanes before release; the volley is one committed action, with real cover and escape lanes. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

Storm Herald's Mantle.name: Storm Herald's Mantle
Storm Herald's Mantle.description: Wrap yourself in a controlled electrical mantle for three exchanges, guiding discharges away from one chosen ally nearby. Each deliberate counterstroke still uses your action, and contact remains hazardous to unprotected companions. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

Judgment of the High Clouds.name: Judgment of the High Clouds
Judgment of the High Clouds.description: Spend two exchanges preparing a towering storm column over a visible outdoor target zone within 80 metres. Unleash one devastating bolt with a thunderous pressure front; shelter, moving out and disrupting preparation all matter. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

Ninefold Thunder Coronation.name: Ninefold Thunder Coronation
Ninefold Thunder Coronation.description: Arrange nine luminous arcs over a twenty-metre battlefield and converge them in one chosen pattern. Two exchanges of visible preparation precede a single overwhelming release; it never grants nine independent attack turns. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

Rime Pin.name: Rime Pin
Rime Pin.description: Launch a slender temporary ice pin at one visible target within 8 metres. It can sting an opening or fasten light cloth to a soft surface; hard armour and cover still resist it. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Coolglass Touch.name: Coolglass Touch
Coolglass Touch.description: Cool one hand-sized object gradually while maintaining contact for several breaths. Useful for a drink, a hot latch or a sample, it does not instantly freeze a living body or repair heat injury. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Frostlip Step.name: Frostlip Step
Frostlip Step.description: Lay a narrow patch of temporary frost across the ground within 3 metres. It can threaten an incautious step for one exchange, while rough footwear, slow movement and heat offer practical counters. Costs 5 Mana on commitment.

Winter Shingle.name: Winter Shingle
Winter Shingle.description: Raise a slanted sheet of temporary ice beside you for one exchange. It can deflect a modest incoming line, then breaks or melts under sustained pressure. Costs 5 Mana on commitment.

Breath of Little Winter.name: Breath of Little Winter
Breath of Little Winter.description: Exhale a short fan of bitter cold up to 4 metres long. It chills exposed surfaces and makes a close approach unpleasant; resolved exposure determines injury rather than guaranteeing frozen lungs. Costs 6 Mana on commitment.

Hoarfrost Clasp.name: Hoarfrost Clasp
Hoarfrost Clasp.description: Grow temporary ice around one visible ankle, hinge or weapon contact within 10 metres. Breaking force, heat and movement can defeat the clasp, whose restraint must actually take hold. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Crystal Skate.name: Crystal Skate
Crystal Skate.description: Prepare a short ice runner under your feet and slide along a clear ground path up to 8 metres. You must control the landing and cannot glide through obstacles or over unsupported air. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Blue Needle Battery.name: Blue Needle Battery
Blue Needle Battery.description: Fan several thin ice needles toward one narrow target zone within 15 metres. The cluster provides coverage in one attack; spreading it among targets divides the pressure. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Rime Garden.name: Rime Garden
Rime Garden.description: Raise jagged temporary frost growth over a three-metre patch within 12 metres for two exchanges. It creates visible difficult footing and low cover, with open routes still usable around its edges. Costs 12 Mana on commitment.

Cold Store Cocoon.name: Cold Store Cocoon
Cold Store Cocoon.description: Surround a small sealed container with insulating ice for up to an hour outside combat. It can preserve an actual sample or provisions; living occupants still need air and safe temperatures. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

White Mirror Ramp.name: White Mirror Ramp
White Mirror Ramp.description: Build a broad sloping ice surface from stable ground across a gap of up to 5 metres. It lasts while maintained, is slippery for everyone and cannot support more weight than its resolved construction bears. Costs 14 Mana on commitment.

Glacier Hammerfall.name: Glacier Hammerfall
Glacier Hammerfall.description: Form a heavy temporary ice mass overhead within 15 metres, then drop it along a clearly visible line. It is a committed crushing attack with warning and real collision, not an unavoidable strike through ceilings. Costs 24 Mana on commitment.

Winterlock Pavilion.name: Winterlock Pavilion
Winterlock Pavilion.description: Enclose a five-metre working space in layered temporary ice for three exchanges. Leave an actual entrance or contest trapping occupants; warmth, impact and your concentration determine its endurance. Costs 28 Mana on commitment.

Hailcourt Procession.name: Hailcourt Procession
Hailcourt Procession.description: Drive a controlled hail front across a ten-metre lane within 30 metres. It forces a dangerous advance or retreat in one sustained attack action, with shelter and allies in the lane treated honestly. Costs 30 Mana on commitment.

Still Lake Rampart.name: Still Lake Rampart
Still Lake Rampart.description: Freeze the surface of an existing body of water across a fifteen-metre stretch over two exchanges. Thickness depends on conditions and effort; deep current, heavy loads and thaw can break the resulting real ice. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

White Silence Engine.name: White Silence Engine
White Silence Engine.description: Draw heat from a visible outdoor zone into a prepared thermal sink over two exchanges. The falling temperature threatens exposed machinery and movement; the sink must withstand the transferred heat and creatures resist actual exposure. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

Palace of the Long Winter.name: Palace of the Long Winter
Palace of the Long Winter.description: Raise a temporary ice bastion across a fifteen-metre site with two exchanges of uninterrupted shaping. Choose its doors, cover and lanes; it provides formidable terrain without creating a permanent palace or freezing occupants automatically. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

The Glacier Remembers.name: The Glacier Remembers
The Glacier Remembers.description: Send a massive ridge of temporary ice advancing along a twenty-metre ground lane. Its grinding movement can split a formation or seal a breach, with visible buildup, contested resistance and no passage through unbroken foundations. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

Sunthread Dart.name: Sunthread Dart
Sunthread Dart.description: Fire a thin flash of concentrated light toward one visible point within 10 metres. It can scorch a small exposed target or pressure an opening; brightness alone does not ignore armour or cover. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Lantern Pearl.name: Lantern Pearl
Lantern Pearl.description: Suspend a soft light above your hand or one touched object for ten minutes. Choose a modest colour and brightness suited to reading or a nearby path; it casts real light visible to others. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Glare Fan.name: Glare Fan
Glare Fan.description: Sweep a sharp flash across a short cone in front of you. It can briefly spoil sight if targets are looking and unprotected, while closed eyes, cover and different senses remain relevant. Costs 5 Mana on commitment.

Moonlit Margin.name: Moonlit Margin
Moonlit Margin.description: Illuminate shallow surface detail with carefully angled light over a page-sized area. It helps reveal ordinary scratches or erased marks when inspected; it neither reads sealed text nor supplies its meaning. Costs 4 Mana on commitment.

Daybreak Line.name: Daybreak Line
Daybreak Line.description: Trace a straight cutting beam across one small visible surface within 12 metres. It can score suitable exposed material or attack one opening, with thickness and reflection affecting penetration. Costs 6 Mana on commitment.

Halo Screen.name: Halo Screen
Halo Screen.description: Arrange a bright haze in a two-metre screen within 8 metres for one exchange. It obscures sightlines and silhouettes movement but has no solid substance and cannot block physical blows. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Borrowed Sunbeam.name: Borrowed Sunbeam
Borrowed Sunbeam.description: Redirect a usable existing light source around one open bend to illuminate a nearby passage. The guided light weakens with distance and stops at opaque barriers. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Starglass Needle.name: Starglass Needle
Starglass Needle.description: Concentrate a pale starlike beam toward one visible target within 25 metres. It favours a precise line and leaves a conspicuous luminous trace during release. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Mirrorbreak Flash.name: Mirrorbreak Flash
Mirrorbreak Flash.description: Flood one visible reflective or visual illusion surface with competing light within 15 metres. The attempt can expose optical inconsistencies; other senses, solid objects and nonvisual magic are not automatically dispelled. Costs 12 Mana on commitment.

Beacon of Safe Return.name: Beacon of Safe Return
Beacon of Safe Return.description: Place a steady luminous beacon on one touched surface for an hour. Its light helps people navigate toward that real point, subject to distance, weather and intervening terrain rather than granting tracking or teleportation. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Prismatic Curtain.name: Prismatic Curtain
Prismatic Curtain.description: Maintain a shifting coloured screen across a four-metre opening for two exchanges. It makes visual aim difficult across the screen for both sides, while projectiles and nonvisual perception remain possible. Costs 14 Mana on commitment.

Solar Needlework.name: Solar Needlework
Solar Needlework.description: Sweep a fine high-energy beam across a chosen visible seam within 30 metres. Careful aim rewards cutting exposed joints or fittings, but an actual attack resolution still determines what yields. Costs 24 Mana on commitment.

Starlit Gallery.name: Starlit Gallery
Starlit Gallery.description: Suspend six small lights across a ten-metre space and direct one chosen illumination pattern each action. They reveal visible movement and deny easy darkness without detecting every hidden creature or acting as automatic weapons. Costs 26 Mana on commitment.

Noonday Spear.name: Noonday Spear
Noonday Spear.description: Focus a brilliant lance down one clear lane up to 40 metres long. Its sustained release is conspicuous and forceful, demanding a stable aim while cover or movement can break the line. Costs 30 Mana on commitment.

Constellation Fusillade.name: Constellation Fusillade
Constellation Fusillade.description: Arrange luminous points around your position and fire a single converging volley toward a visible zone within 35 metres. Spread and concentration are chosen before release; the pattern grants coverage, not extra actions. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

Daystar Bastion.name: Daystar Bastion
Daystar Bastion.description: Create a dazzling dome of controlled light over a ten-metre site for three exchanges. It can deny visual concealment and pressure exposed approaches, but provides no physical wall or restorative Healing effect. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

White Horizon Verdict.name: White Horizon Verdict
White Horizon Verdict.description: Spend two exchanges aligning a narrow beam along an unobstructed outdoor lane up to 100 metres. Its overwhelming heat and glare strike that line once; the alignment is visible and cannot curve through buildings. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

The Borrowed Dawn.name: The Borrowed Dawn
The Borrowed Dawn.description: Lift a radiant sphere over a twenty-metre battlefield for three exchanges, illuminating even deep ordinary shadow. Each deliberate damaging beam requires your action; the dawn does not heal allies, reveal private thoughts or neutralize every shadow spell. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

Iron Fleck.name: Iron Fleck
Iron Fleck.description: Flick a small temporary metal shard toward one visible target within 6 metres. It is a simple sharp projectile that vanishes after the exchange and cannot become saleable ammunition. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Tinkerer's Pinch.name: Tinkerer's Pinch
Tinkerer's Pinch.description: Bend or straighten a small exposed piece of ordinary soft metal held in your hand. It helps with wire, a bent pin or a simple clasp, without automatically defeating a complex lock or enchantment. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Silver Seam.name: Silver Seam
Silver Seam.description: Reinforce one small metal seam you can touch for an exchange. Existing workmanship determines its strength, and the reinforcement adds no independent magical attack to the item. Costs 5 Mana on commitment.

Tinleaf Guard.name: Tinleaf Guard
Tinleaf Guard.description: Unfold a temporary metal leaf beside your hand to meet one incoming line. It can turn a modest blow with correct timing, then crumples rather than becoming permanent armour. Costs 5 Mana on commitment.

Rivet Rain.name: Rivet Rain
Rivet Rain.description: Drive several loose metal pieces in a short fan up to 8 metres. Use actual pieces or temporary conjuration; the fan is one attack and does not choose hidden targets. Costs 6 Mana on commitment.

Locksmith's Listening Hand.name: Locksmith's Listening Hand
Locksmith's Listening Hand.description: Feel mechanical resistance through a touched metal fitting while shaping a fine probe. You must still understand and work the mechanism; this reveals neither a magical password nor a guaranteed opening. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Ironhook Tether.name: Ironhook Tether
Ironhook Tether.description: Extend a temporary metal hook and line up to 5 metres to catch a visible ledge or loose object. Weight, anchoring and a resisting holder are resolved normally; the line needs your support. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Bladegrain Temper.name: Bladegrain Temper
Bladegrain Temper.description: Align the structure of one touched real metal blade for a scene, reducing a minor defect or improving its edge. Cracks and missing material require actual repair, and existing enchantments are not copied. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Chainwright's Knot.name: Chainwright's Knot
Chainwright's Knot.description: Shape temporary links around one exposed limb or object within 10 metres. The links must close and withstand resistance; releasing or breaking concentration makes conjured metal fade. Costs 12 Mana on commitment.

Orewhisper Sorting.name: Orewhisper Sorting
Orewhisper Sorting.description: Separate visibly mixed metal-bearing fragments from a small prepared batch over several minutes. It improves sorting of existing material, not automatic purification, unknown mineral identification or creation of new ore. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Mercury Fan.name: Mercury Fan
Mercury Fan.description: Shape a fan of temporary fluid-looking metal into a flexible striking ribbon up to 6 metres long. Its appearance does not give it poison properties; control and the single attack determine where it lands. Costs 14 Mana on commitment.

Foundry Spear.name: Foundry Spear
Foundry Spear.description: Extrude a heavy temporary metal lance and drive it along one visible lane within 20 metres. It brings powerful penetration pressure with a committed release and no permanent metal left to collect. Costs 24 Mana on commitment.

Iron Petal Bastion.name: Iron Petal Bastion
Iron Petal Bastion.description: Raise overlapping temporary plates across a five-metre arc for three exchanges. They create strong cover whose gaps, supports and remaining integrity can be attacked. Costs 28 Mana on commitment.

Bellmetal Recasting.name: Bellmetal Recasting
Bellmetal Recasting.description: Over a prepared workshop session reshape and rebalance a manageable quantity of real metal into a known form. Tools, available mass and craftsmanship matter; complex mechanisms and enchantments need their own work. Costs 30 Mana on commitment.

Stariron Procession.name: Stariron Procession
Stariron Procession.description: Guide a row of heavy temporary metal blades along a chosen ten-metre ground lane. Resolve the formation as one attack; it threatens a broad path without hunting targets or operating beyond your attention. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

Mineral Crown Transmutation.name: Mineral Crown Transmutation
Mineral Crown Transmutation.description: With a prepared furnace and tested feedstock, transmute a small batch of real metallic minerals into a different workable composition. Preserve mass, account for impurities and expenditure, and resolve the project rather than freely printing precious bullion. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

Thousand Rivet Citadel.name: Thousand Rivet Citadel
Thousand Rivet Citadel.description: Build a temporary interlocking metal barricade across a fifteen-metre breach over two exchanges. Its structure can bear a siege for a time, but requires sound anchoring and leaves no permanent ore when dismissed. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

The Mountain's Hidden Heart.name: The Mountain's Hidden Heart
The Mountain's Hidden Heart.description: Draw an immense temporary metal form around your position and commit it to one crushing sweep or towering guard. Two exchanges of preparation and a clear working space are required; its scale offers no automatic control of others' equipment. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

Thornlet Dart.name: Thornlet Dart
Thornlet Dart.description: Launch one small temporary thorn toward a visible target within 8 metres. It can sting an opening or fasten light cloth; it carries no poison unless an actual separately prepared substance is used. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Greenfinger Tending.name: Greenfinger Tending
Greenfinger Tending.description: Support one touched small plant's recovery from minor drying or damage over a few minutes. It needs real water, light and viable tissue; this does not heal people, animals or an already dead plant. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Rootlace.name: Rootlace
Rootlace.description: Grow temporary grasping roots across a metre of visible ground within 6 metres. They can catch a careless step for an exchange, with strength, footing and cutting tools providing real resistance. Costs 5 Mana on commitment.

Leafscreen Fold.name: Leafscreen Fold
Leafscreen Fold.description: Fan temporary broad leaves into a short visual screen within reach. It lasts two exchanges and offers concealment rather than armour, with gaps, wind and flame affecting it. Costs 5 Mana on commitment.

Seedkeeper's Sense.name: Seedkeeper's Sense
Seedkeeper's Sense.description: Examine a touched living seed or plant for ordinary signs of stress, dormancy or blight. The impression supports skilled investigation without naming an unknown disease or reading a creature's thoughts. Costs 6 Mana on commitment.

Briar Hook.name: Briar Hook
Briar Hook.description: Send a hooked temporary vine toward one exposed object within 10 metres. Use it to snag, pull or contest a limb; anchoring and the target's resistance limit what can actually be moved. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Arbor Splint.name: Arbor Splint
Arbor Splint.description: Grow a shaped temporary wooden brace around a damaged real plant or a broken tool shaft. It supports the existing object for a scene but does not restore missing tissue or repair machinery by itself. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Pollen Lantern.name: Pollen Lantern
Pollen Lantern.description: Float luminous temporary pollen across a three-metre patch for two exchanges. Disturbed grains can show nearby movement and air currents, with visibility and wind affecting what is actually noticed. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Thorncourt Wheel.name: Thorncourt Wheel
Thorncourt Wheel.description: Sweep a ring of temporary briars through a three-metre arc around you. It pressures close attackers in one resolved action, leaving no automatic damage field behind it. Costs 12 Mana on commitment.

Grafting Hour.name: Grafting Hour
Grafting Hour.description: Guide a careful graft between compatible real plants during a working session. Real stock, clean cuts and later care remain necessary; unusual hybrids require research rather than an instant harvest. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Canopy Bridge.name: Canopy Bridge
Canopy Bridge.description: Weave temporary branches between sound anchors across a gap up to 6 metres. The bridge lasts while maintained and must actually bear its occupants, with fire or damaged anchors threatening it. Costs 14 Mana on commitment.

Waking Bramble Maze.name: Waking Bramble Maze
Waking Bramble Maze.description: Raise temporary thorn walls across a six-metre site for three exchanges. Choose clear corridors before shaping; creatures inside can resist enclosure or cut their way through rather than becoming helpless. Costs 24 Mana on commitment.

Greenhouse Shepherd.name: Greenhouse Shepherd
Greenhouse Shepherd.description: Tend a small real growing plot for several hours, directing healthy growth with available water, soil and nutrients. It improves husbandry without creating instant food or replacing a whole season's material needs. Costs 26 Mana on commitment.

Ironbark Colonnade.name: Ironbark Colonnade
Ironbark Colonnade.description: Raise temporary wooden pillars and heavy branches across a ten-metre ground site. They can support cover or brace a damaged roof for a scene, subject to sound placement and the weight involved. Costs 30 Mana on commitment.

Orchard of Hungry Thorns.name: Orchard of Hungry Thorns
Orchard of Hungry Thorns.description: Shape a broad temporary thicket across a fifteen-metre lane and direct one constricting movement each action. It contests creatures it reaches; it is neither an independent army nor a permanent cultivated orchard. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

Rootwarden's Audience.name: Rootwarden's Audience
Rootwarden's Audience.description: Follow the physical root network of a living grove while touching its trunk for several minutes. You sense major damage and disturbances through connected living growth, not speech, memories or events beyond that network. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

Cathedral of the Green Crown.name: Cathedral of the Green Crown
Cathedral of the Green Crown.description: Raise a temporary vaulted grove over a fifteen-metre site with two exchanges of shaping. Its huge branches create cover and routes, with real supports and openings; living occupants are not healed by entering it. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

The Forest Takes a Breath.name: The Forest Takes a Breath
The Forest Takes a Breath.description: Coordinate a surge through existing living vegetation over a twenty-metre site, bending branches and roots into one immense restraining movement. Plants must actually be present and survive the effort; creatures resist the grip and stone foundations remain obstacles. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

Knuckle Chime.name: Knuckle Chime
Knuckle Chime.description: Send a compact vibration into one visible surface or exposed target within 5 metres. It produces a sharp knock that can distract or strike lightly, with the material and actual contact shaping its effect. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Pocket Hush.name: Pocket Hush
Pocket Hush.description: Dampen ordinary sound in a hand-sized space for a minute. Quiet a rattling clasp or a small working tool; voices and impacts outside that tiny space remain audible. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Bellskip Pulse.name: Bellskip Pulse
Bellskip Pulse.description: Bounce a brief audible ping from a visible hard surface within 10 metres. Its echo can help judge an open corner when listened to, without mapping hidden rooms or identifying unseen creatures automatically. Costs 5 Mana on commitment.

Whisper Spool.name: Whisper Spool
Whisper Spool.description: Carry a quiet spoken phrase along an unobstructed air path to one listener within 12 metres. Others near the path may overhear, and the spell provides neither encryption nor translation. Costs 5 Mana on commitment.

Shiverbolt.name: Shiverbolt
Shiverbolt.description: Fire a narrow pulse of vibration at one visible target within 10 metres. A clean hit can jar a grip or concentration, but tough materials, bracing and practiced casting can resist it. Costs 6 Mana on commitment.

Quieting Collar.name: Quieting Collar
Quieting Collar.description: Reduce ordinary sound around one willing nearby creature for two exchanges. It helps a careful approach without making footsteps impossible to detect or disabling another caster's body casting. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Resonant Probe.name: Resonant Probe
Resonant Probe.description: Send a tuned note through a touched object and listen for changes indicating cracks or hollow spaces. Interpretation needs knowledge of the material; active magic and complex assemblies can muddy the result. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Boomstep Ring.name: Boomstep Ring
Boomstep Ring.description: Release a short pressure ring from your stance across 3 metres. It can stagger nearby approaches in one resolved burst, with bracing, distance and obstructions affecting the result. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Discordant Thread.name: Discordant Thread
Discordant Thread.description: Match a heard sustained tone or chant and introduce a competing vibration within 15 metres. This can disrupt a sound-dependent working, but does not automatically counter silent or unrelated magic. Costs 12 Mana on commitment.

Echo Jar.name: Echo Jar
Echo Jar.description: Store up to a minute of sound you can actually hear in a touched resonant vessel, then replay it once. It preserves that recording rather than inventing words or granting the original speaker's authority. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Glassbreak Cadence.name: Glassbreak Cadence
Glassbreak Cadence.description: Build resonance in one exposed brittle object within 12 metres over an exchange, then release a concentrated note. Its real construction and damping determine whether it cracks; living bodies are not treated as convenient glass vessels. Costs 14 Mana on commitment.

Rolling Thunder Room.name: Rolling Thunder Room
Rolling Thunder Room.description: Drive a focused low-frequency wave through a six-metre interior space. It jars unsecured objects and threatens balance in one attack, while solid partitions and prepared bracing reduce its reach. Costs 24 Mana on commitment.

Silent Study Pavilion.name: Silent Study Pavilion
Silent Study Pavilion.description: Maintain a five-metre zone of reduced ordinary noise for a scene. Conversation inside can stay quiet and concentration improves, but solid impacts and sufficiently strong sound can still carry through. Costs 26 Mana on commitment.

Resonance Sever.name: Resonance Sever
Resonance Sever.description: Focus a cutting vibration along one visible material seam within 20 metres. A stable aim and knowledge of the structure reward precision; enchantments and dense materials resist instead of universally shattering. Costs 30 Mana on commitment.

Choir of Broken Footing.name: Choir of Broken Footing
Choir of Broken Footing.description: Layer pressure pulses over a ten-metre ground lane to contest a formation's footing. Resolve the coordinated disturbance once, with allies, supports and escape routes included rather than granting repeated stuns. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

Listener Beneath Stone.name: Listener Beneath Stone
Listener Beneath Stone.description: While still and touching a continuous structure, follow major vibrations through it across up to 40 metres. You can distinguish rough movement patterns, not faces, thoughts or an exact map through disconnected foundations. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

Cathedral Bell Verdict.name: Cathedral Bell Verdict
Cathedral Bell Verdict.description: Spend two exchanges gathering a vast tuned pressure front, then release it across a fifteen-metre cone. Its tremendous sound and force threaten hearing and structures honestly, including unprotected allies in its path. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

The World Holds Its Voice.name: The World Holds Its Voice
The World Holds Its Voice.description: Maintain a twenty-metre field that heavily damps ordinary sound for three exchanges. It enables coordinated silent movement but leaves visual communication and body casting intact; powerful opposing vibrations can contest its edges. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

Little Downward Nudge.name: Little Downward Nudge
Little Downward Nudge.description: Increase the apparent weight of one small visible loose object within 5 metres for a breath. It may topple a cup or delay a moving part; secured objects and living targets are not automatically pinned. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Feather Parcel.name: Feather Parcel
Feather Parcel.description: Lighten one hand-carried parcel for a minute while you remain in contact. Its mass and inertia still matter, and letting go ends the support rather than launching the object into orbit. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Heelweight.name: Heelweight
Heelweight.description: Apply a brief downward pull to one visible foot-sized point within 8 metres. A well-timed hit can disturb a step, while bracing and movement contest the pull. Costs 5 Mana on commitment.

Slowfall Thread.name: Slowfall Thread
Slowfall Thread.description: Reduce the descent of yourself or one willing creature within reach for an exchange. You must catch the fall early enough and still find a real landing; this does not provide flight or negate every impact. Costs 5 Mana on commitment.

Orbit Pebble.name: Orbit Pebble
Orbit Pebble.description: Hold a few small loose stones in a slow orbit near your hand for two exchanges. Releasing them as one aimed throw uses your action; the orbit gives neither automatic defence nor extra attack turns. Costs 6 Mana on commitment.

Heavy Door Courtesy.name: Heavy Door Courtesy
Heavy Door Courtesy.description: Shift the downward load on one visible door, lid or small mechanism within 10 metres. This can hold or ease its motion, but hinges, locks and another person's resistance still matter. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Tilted Step.name: Tilted Step
Tilted Step.description: Lean your personal downward pull slightly toward a nearby stable surface for one short traverse. It aids a difficult incline rather than letting you walk unsupported across open air. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Stonefall Lance.name: Stonefall Lance
Stonefall Lance.description: Accelerate a small real or temporary projectile down a visible lane up to 15 metres. It strikes once with concentrated force and needs a clear path, without importing unlimited matter. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Gravitic Bowl.name: Gravitic Bowl
Gravitic Bowl.description: Create a three-metre depression in local pull centred on a visible point within 12 metres. Loose objects and unsecured footing tend inward for one exchange; creatures and anchored structures resist normally. Costs 12 Mana on commitment.

Porter's Invisible Sling.name: Porter's Invisible Sling
Porter's Invisible Sling.description: Suspend one manageable object within 5 metres and guide it slowly for a minute. Size, load and concentration limit the lift; a living or resisting target requires a separate contested attempt. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Falling Wall.name: Falling Wall
Falling Wall.description: Turn the direction of a brief pull across a three-metre plane within 12 metres. It can redirect a modest approaching mass or disturb a crossing, with heavy momentum contesting the change. Costs 14 Mana on commitment.

Orbitkeeper's Wheel.name: Orbitkeeper's Wheel
Orbitkeeper's Wheel.description: Arrange several heavy loose objects in a controlled ring and commit them to one sweep within 15 metres. Safe distances and cover matter, and uncommitted orbiting debris does not attack independently. Costs 24 Mana on commitment.

Kneeling Giant.name: Kneeling Giant
Kneeling Giant.description: Concentrate downward force across a visible three-metre target zone within 20 metres for two exchanges. Movement and resistance determine who is held; it cannot guarantee crushing a powerful creature merely by naming its weight. Costs 28 Mana on commitment.

Skyhook Traverse.name: Skyhook Traverse
Skyhook Traverse.description: Support yourself and one willing companion along an open airborne path up to 20 metres, then lower both onto a real landing. Sustained flight and carrying larger groups require a stronger working. Costs 30 Mana on commitment.

Black Bell Impact.name: Black Bell Impact
Black Bell Impact.description: Build a dense point of pull above a visible ground lane and release it as a single crushing wave. Its ten-metre reach is finite and avoidable; it creates no singularity, permanent gravity well or instant disintegration. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

Suspended Processional.name: Suspended Processional
Suspended Processional.description: Hold a small prepared group or load aloft while slowly crossing an open space up to 40 metres. Maintain concentration and actual weight limits; protecting the travellers and choosing a safe landing remain necessary. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

Court of the Falling Sky.name: Court of the Falling Sky
Court of the Falling Sky.description: Shape a powerful fifteen-metre gravity field over two exchanges, then choose one direction of sustained pull for three exchanges. Opponents contest its influence and anchored buildings do not automatically tear free. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

The Mountain Forgets Its Weight.name: The Mountain Forgets Its Weight
The Mountain Forgets Its Weight.description: Lift one immense but bounded detached load from a prepared site for a brief controlled relocation. Survey its supports and destination first; this is a demanding feat of mass handling, not continent moving or Space teleportation. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

Folded Reach.name: Folded Reach
Folded Reach.description: Shorten the final few centimetres between your fingers and a visible loose object within arm's reach. Nothing passes through a barrier, and an unwilling holder can resist the attempted touch or retrieval. Costs 4 Mana on commitment.

Nearside Slip.name: Nearside Slip
Nearside Slip.description: Displace yourself up to one metre to an unoccupied point you can directly see on the same continuous floor. It is a deliberate move with an actual landing, not an automatic reaction or passage through a locked barrier. Costs 5 Mana on commitment.

Bent Needle.name: Bent Needle
Bent Needle.description: Fold the route of one small thrown object around a single visible obstruction within 6 metres. Both ends and the safe path must be perceived; this changes its delivery line rather than guaranteeing a hit. Costs 7 Mana on commitment.

Handspan Shelter.name: Handspan Shelter
Handspan Shelter.description: Create a momentary shallow spatial fold beside one exposed point on your body. It can shift one precisely timed contact off line, while broad attacks and poor timing can defeat the small shelter. Costs 7 Mana on commitment.

Threshold Stitch.name: Threshold Stitch
Threshold Stitch.description: Align two visible open points up to 2 metres apart long enough to pass one hand-sized object between them. Neither endpoint can lie inside a creature, solid material or a closed container. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Three-Step Elsewhere.name: Three-Step Elsewhere
Three-Step Elsewhere.description: Teleport yourself up to 3 metres to a clearly perceived safe point in the same immediate space. Carry only worn and held equipment; wards and contested spatial interference can spoil the move without inventing a destination. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Foldline Hook.name: Foldline Hook
Foldline Hook.description: Bend a short visible path so a held rope or pole can reach around one open corner within 5 metres. The real tool still needs contact and leverage, and the fold cannot solve an unknown sealed mechanism. Costs 12 Mana on commitment.

Farhand Exchange.name: Farhand Exchange
Farhand Exchange.description: Swap two willing or unattended hand-sized objects you can directly see within 8 metres. Their surroundings must have room for the exchange; ownership and resistance do not disappear because the movement is spatial. Costs 12 Mana on commitment.

Doorway Without a Door.name: Doorway Without a Door
Doorway Without a Door.description: Open a small temporary aperture between two directly visible open points within 8 metres for one exchange. It can pass a compact object or spell with careful aim; it is too small for a person and grants no extra attack action. Costs 14 Mana on commitment.

Distance Stutter.name: Distance Stutter
Distance Stutter.description: Lengthen a two-metre strip of open ground into several awkward extra paces for one exchange. Creatures crossing can perceive and contest the distortion; it does not move them to another location or trap them forever. Costs 14 Mana on commitment.

Companion's Sidestep.name: Companion's Sidestep
Companion's Sidestep.description: Move yourself and one willing creature in contact up to 5 metres to a directly seen safe landing. Both leave and arrive together, and the committed action cannot be used to pull a resisting captive without a contest. Costs 16 Mana on commitment.

Folded Gallery.name: Folded Gallery
Folded Gallery.description: Create a person-sized shortcut between two directly visible points within 15 metres for one exchange. Traversal uses actual movement, has finite capacity and cannot penetrate a sealed barrier or cross a realm boundary. Costs 26 Mana on commitment.

Seam of the Empty Blade.name: Seam of the Empty Blade
Seam of the Empty Blade.description: Project a short spatial shear along one visible exposed edge within 10 metres. Resolve a dangerous cutting attack against material and magical resistance; no cut is placed inside an unseen organ or treated as unavoidable. Costs 30 Mana on commitment.

Borrowed Interval of Road.name: Borrowed Interval of Road
