Borrowed Interval of Road.description: Spend an exchange aligning a safe short route, then carry a willing small group up to 30 metres between observed open landings. Wards, carried mass and interrupted preparation matter; this is spatial travel, not Time manipulation. Costs 34 Mana on commitment.

Wayfarer's Inscribed Return.name: Wayfarer's Inscribed Return
Wayfarer's Inscribed Return.description: Over several uninterrupted minutes prepare a one-way return to a surveyed anchor within the same region, then resolve the journey. You must have personally learned the safe landing and retain its real anchor; the return succeeds only when the passage and safe landing are resolved. Costs 45 Mana on commitment.

Atlas Thread Passage.name: Atlas Thread Passage
Atlas Thread Passage.description: Prepare a long-distance crossing to a personally surveyed existing destination using a stable destination anchor, suitable materials and several minutes of work. Resolve actual realm, location and area changes; this neither creates a new realm nor activates a public court portal without its key. Costs 50 Mana on commitment.

Pilgrims Through the Fold.name: Pilgrims Through the Fold
Pilgrims Through the Fold.description: Open a prepared group passage between genuinely learned existing destinations for a short ordered crossing. Anchors, ward permissions, total load and destination safety must be established; passage ends if preparation fails, with no invented successful arrival. Costs 65 Mana on commitment.

The Horizon Takes One Step.name: The Horizon Takes One Step
The Horizon Takes One Step.description: After a substantial surveyed preparation, bridge a great distance between two actual stable anchors in existing realms for one carefully controlled transit. Court-network authorizations remain separate, and unknown landings, sealed dungeon progression and Time effects cannot be bypassed by claiming mastery. Costs 70 Mana on commitment.

Hollow Dart.name: Hollow Dart
Hollow Dart.description: Send a narrow pulse of absent light toward one visible target within 6 metres. It strikes with a brief numbing pressure rather than draining a living creature's personal Mana reserve. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Shade Hem.name: Shade Hem
Shade Hem.description: Deepen the shadow along your outline for a minute in existing low light. It helps an actual attempt to stay unnoticed but provides no invisibility in clear view or teleportation between shadows. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Unlit Pinch.name: Unlit Pinch
Unlit Pinch.description: Suppress a small ordinary flame's light within reach for a breath without removing its heat. Magical illumination and a stronger light source can resist or overwhelm the effect. Costs 5 Mana on commitment.

Blank Thread.name: Blank Thread
Blank Thread.description: Fray one weak exposed magical thread within 6 metres after observing its shape. This contests a specific simple effect rather than cancelling every spell, item enchantment or a creature's trained ability. Costs 5 Mana on commitment.

Shadowhook.name: Shadowhook
Shadowhook.description: Cast a temporary dark tether toward one visible object within 8 metres. It can tug a loose item or contest a grip; it requires an actual line and cannot extract life, souls or personal Mana. Costs 6 Mana on commitment.

Empty Palm Screen.name: Empty Palm Screen
Empty Palm Screen.description: Hold a small dampening plane against one incoming magical line for an exchange. Compare the opposing workings normally; forceful attacks can break through, and physical weapons still need a physical defence. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Duskstep Cover.name: Duskstep Cover
Duskstep Cover.description: Pull nearby shade across a two-metre patch for two exchanges. It can obscure a real movement through that patch without moving anyone instantly or making light-sensitive creatures automatically helpless. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Hungerless Seal.name: Hungerless Seal
Hungerless Seal.description: Place a temporary dampening mark on one unattended minor magical device within reach. It can quiet a weak function for a scene if the attempt succeeds, without consuming the device's charge or granting it to you. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Black Ribbon Cut.name: Black Ribbon Cut
Black Ribbon Cut.description: Send a thin dark edge toward one visible spell connection within 12 metres. A successful contest can sever that connection, while independent portions and stronger anchors may remain active. Costs 12 Mana on commitment.

Silhouette Borrower.name: Silhouette Borrower
Silhouette Borrower.description: Spread an existing ordinary shadow into a larger visual decoy for two exchanges. It alters only shadow and light, leaving sound, touch and careful inspection able to expose it. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Quiet Null Pocket.name: Quiet Null Pocket
Quiet Null Pocket.description: Create a hand-sized dampened space around a touched unstable magical sample for a minute. It helps contain a modest leak; pressure beyond its capacity escapes, and storage is not free permanent containment. Costs 14 Mana on commitment.

Nightfall Javelin.name: Nightfall Javelin
Nightfall Javelin.description: Cast a dense void lance down a visible lane within 25 metres. Its strike contests magical protection at the impact point without globally suppressing the target's disciplines or consuming their soul. Costs 24 Mana on commitment.

Circle of Unspoken Sparks.name: Circle of Unspoken Sparks
Circle of Unspoken Sparks.description: Maintain a five-metre dampening circle for two exchanges that contests weak ongoing magical effects inside it. Allies' affected workings are equally exposed, and powerful spells can resist or break the circle. Costs 28 Mana on commitment.

Unravel the Borrowed Crown.name: Unravel the Borrowed Crown
Unravel the Borrowed Crown.description: Study one sustained external enchantment for an exchange, then attempt to peel away its supporting pattern. Actual complexity and resistance decide success; intrinsic species traits and permanent history are not removable spell threads. Costs 30 Mana on commitment.

Blackglass Passage Screen.name: Blackglass Passage Screen
Blackglass Passage Screen.description: Raise a ten-metre curtain of dense shadow and magical interference for three exchanges. It conceals a real route and pressures attacks crossing it without becoming a universal wall, new location or silent teleport. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

The Spell's Empty Seat.name: The Spell's Empty Seat
The Spell's Empty Seat.description: Prepare a precisely shaped gap to receive one observed magical attack, then contest its release with your action. A changed attack, multiple lines or stronger force can defeat the counter, which does not refund spent Mana. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

Night That Eats the Lanterns.name: Night That Eats the Lanterns
Night That Eats the Lanterns.description: Spend two exchanges building a fifteen-metre field that contests sustained external magical effects. Allies and enemies face the same suppression, resistant workings survive, and living reserves remain untouched. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

The Final Unwritten Line.name: The Final Unwritten Line
The Final Unwritten Line.description: After carefully reading a single major magical structure, commit a concentrated unravelling at its weakest accessible anchor. It is an exceptional contested dismantling requiring two exposed setup exchanges, not an automatic erasure of artifacts, realms or living beings. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

Kindly Stitch.name: Kindly Stitch
Kindly Stitch.description: Touch a willing creature and treat one fresh superficial wound, restoring up to 5% of their maximum Health once if treatment succeeds. It needs viable tissue and a clean enough site; it does not cure poison, exhaustion or lost limbs. Round restoration down, cap it at actual maximum Health, and apply an already resolved recovery only once. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Still the Tremor.name: Still the Tremor
Still the Tremor.description: Steady one willing creature's minor physical tremor through a brief touch. It can make a simple task or examination easier for a few breaths, without controlling emotions or treating a serious disease. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Warm Pulse Examination.name: Warm Pulse Examination
Warm Pulse Examination.description: Examine a willing touched creature for broad signs of bleeding, shock or abnormal vital rhythms. The impression guides treatment rather than supplying an infallible diagnosis or reading private memories. Costs 5 Mana on commitment.

Clean Margin.name: Clean Margin
Clean Margin.description: Help clean and close the edge of one small contaminated wound through direct careful treatment. It supports ordinary hygiene and reduces a local threat; it neither sterilizes an entire body nor neutralizes every toxin. Costs 6 Mana on commitment.

Merciful Pressure.name: Merciful Pressure
Merciful Pressure.description: Control active bleeding in one touched willing creature while holding attention for an exchange. Restore up to 12% of their maximum Health once on success; deep damage and the cause of the wound still need proper care. Round restoration down, cap it at actual maximum Health, and apply an already resolved recovery only once. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Nervequiet Touch.name: Nervequiet Touch
Nervequiet Touch.description: Reduce localized pain in one willing touched creature for a scene so treatment or evacuation is possible. Injury still limits safe exertion, and pain relief grants neither restored Stamina nor permission to ignore a broken limb. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Bonekeeper's Cradle.name: Bonekeeper's Cradle
Bonekeeper's Cradle.description: Guide a freshly set simple fracture toward stable repair during several uninterrupted minutes of treatment. Restore up to 15% of the patient's maximum Health once on success; alignment, tissue damage and aftercare still matter. Round restoration down, cap it at actual maximum Health, and apply an already resolved recovery only once. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Feverwatch Thread.name: Feverwatch Thread
Feverwatch Thread.description: Support one willing patient's response to a diagnosed ordinary infection over a treatment session. Appropriate medicine and real rest improve the attempt; unknown magical diseases and severe systemic illness need further investigation. Costs 12 Mana on commitment.

Breath Returned to Rhythm.name: Breath Returned to Rhythm
Breath Returned to Rhythm.description: Stabilize one living creature suffering reversible respiratory distress through touch and an exchange of focused care. Restore up to 18% of their maximum Health once if successful, without resurrecting the dead or replacing air in a sealed space. Round restoration down, cap it at actual maximum Health, and apply an already resolved recovery only once. Costs 12 Mana on commitment.

Patient's Small Sanctuary.name: Patient's Small Sanctuary
Patient's Small Sanctuary.description: Maintain a calm treatment field around one willing patient within reach for three exchanges. It steadies your careful work and shields exposed wounds from minor contamination, without repeated passive healing or a combat barrier. Costs 14 Mana on commitment.

Scarweaver's Lesson.name: Scarweaver's Lesson
Scarweaver's Lesson.description: Spend a quiet treatment session working on a healed but limiting ordinary scar or soft-tissue injury. Resolve actual improvement and up to 25% of the patient's maximum Health restored once; old curses, missing tissue and exceptional wounds can resist repair. Round restoration down, cap it at actual maximum Health, and apply an already resolved recovery only once. Costs 24 Mana on commitment.

Golden Thread Triage.name: Golden Thread Triage
Golden Thread Triage.description: Treat up to three willing creatures gathered within 3 metres during one focused exchange. Share one restoration budget equal to 30% of your own maximum Health between successful treatments, rounding down; it is not that amount for each patient. Round restoration down, cap it at actual maximum Health, and apply an already resolved recovery only once. Costs 28 Mana on commitment.

Venom's Unwelcome Guest.name: Venom's Unwelcome Guest
Venom's Unwelcome Guest.description: Target a diagnosed ordinary toxin in one willing patient during a focused treatment session. A successful purge reduces its real burden and may restore up to 15% of the patient's maximum Health once, while unfamiliar magical venoms require a specific remedy. Round restoration down, cap it at actual maximum Health, and apply an already resolved recovery only once. Costs 30 Mana on commitment.

Hands That Hold the Door.name: Hands That Hold the Door
Hands That Hold the Door.description: Keep one critically injured living creature stable during three exchanges of direct continuous treatment. Restore up to 35% of their maximum Health once on success; leaving or further severe damage can end stabilization, and death already established is not reversed. Round restoration down, cap it at actual maximum Health, and apply an already resolved recovery only once. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

Rejoin the Living Pattern.name: Rejoin the Living Pattern
Rejoin the Living Pattern.description: During a protected clinical session repair severe but viable tissue damage with actual materials and anatomical knowledge. Restore up to 45% of the patient's maximum Health once on success; missing limbs, ancient damage and magical scars can require separate exceptional projects. Round restoration down, cap it at actual maximum Health, and apply an already resolved recovery only once. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

The Ward Beneath the Rain.name: The Ward Beneath the Rain
The Ward Beneath the Rain.description: Tend a gathered group over several uninterrupted minutes. Share one restoration budget equal to 60% of your own maximum Health between willing patients, rounding down; prioritize viable treatment rather than granting each patient full restoration or curing every illness. Round restoration down, cap it at actual maximum Health, and apply an already resolved recovery only once. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

Mercy's Unbroken Thread.name: Mercy's Unbroken Thread
Mercy's Unbroken Thread.description: Commit sustained master-level treatment to one living patient whose injuries still admit repair, restoring up to 70% of their maximum Health once on success. It needs a protected treatment period and aftercare; it grants no resurrection, agelessness or Mana refill. Round restoration down, cap it at actual maximum Health, and apply an already resolved recovery only once. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

Suregrip Sigil.name: Suregrip Sigil
Suregrip Sigil.description: Place a temporary grip-steadying mark on one held tool or weapon for two exchanges. It helps its actual user resist a slip, while disarming force, poor technique and damage still matter. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Little Latch Charm.name: Little Latch Charm
Little Latch Charm.description: Charm one simple touched latch to remain in its current position for a minute. Someone can still force or carefully work it; the charm neither creates a lock nor grants access to a secured room. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Bright Edge Courtesy.name: Bright Edge Courtesy
Bright Edge Courtesy.description: Give a held edge a brief sharpening enchantment for one exchange. Its user resolves an actual strike with the improved edge, receiving no independent hit or permanent weapon upgrade. Costs 5 Mana on commitment.

Threadkeeper's Knot.name: Threadkeeper's Knot
Threadkeeper's Knot.description: Give a touched strap, seam or rope knot extra resilience for a scene. Its real material still bears the load, and this is reinforcement rather than replacement for a broken fastening. Costs 5 Mana on commitment.

Return to Hand.name: Return to Hand
Return to Hand.description: Mark one small held object so it drifts back to your open hand from up to 3 metres away during the next exchange. A resisting holder, obstacles or a secured attachment can stop the return. Costs 6 Mana on commitment.

Quiet Sole Script.name: Quiet Sole Script
Quiet Sole Script.description: Enchant a willing creature's footwear to soften ordinary footfall for a scene. Careful movement remains necessary, and creaking floors, loose equipment and visual observation can expose them. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Gleaming Practice Partner.name: Gleaming Practice Partner
Gleaming Practice Partner.description: Charm one training prop to repeat a simple demonstrated motion within its real reach for a minute. It is a drill tool with a visible pattern, not an autonomous intelligent fighter or a free companion attack. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Bearer's Ease.name: Bearer's Ease
Bearer's Ease.description: Enchant one worn pack to distribute its load more comfortably for a scene. It can aid a real carrying task without deleting the cargo's mass or supplying free Stamina restoration. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Rebuff Rune.name: Rebuff Rune
Rebuff Rune.description: Place a temporary defensive mark on a touched shield or armour piece for two exchanges. It strengthens one deliberately resolved defence, then fades; it does not automatically repel every hit or attack for the wearer. Costs 12 Mana on commitment.

Faithful Ink.name: Faithful Ink
Faithful Ink.description: Charm a prepared page so fresh mundane alterations briefly shimmer during the next hour. It helps detect interference with that page, not decide whether its original contents were true or compel anyone to obey a contract. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Courier's Patient Thread.name: Courier's Patient Thread
Courier's Patient Thread.description: Enchant a small unattended object to follow a demonstrated safe route up to 20 metres while you watch. It can deliver an actual item, with doors, collisions and resistance interrupting the simple instruction. Costs 14 Mana on commitment.

Runes of the Steady Heart.name: Runes of the Steady Heart
Runes of the Steady Heart.description: Temporarily support a willing creature's coordination under ordinary fear for three exchanges. They retain their feelings and decisions; this steadies performance without compulsory courage, obedience or guaranteed success. Costs 24 Mana on commitment.

Weapon's Borrowed Memory.name: Weapon's Borrowed Memory
Weapon's Borrowed Memory.description: After observing a willing trained wielder, tune their real weapon to support one familiar manoeuvre for a scene. It reinforces practiced technique and cannot transfer mastery, invent a spell or replace the wielder's action. Costs 28 Mana on commitment.

Wardwright's Palimpsest.name: Wardwright's Palimpsest
Wardwright's Palimpsest.description: Inspect and reinforce an existing compatible protective enchantment over a working session. Preserve its actual scope and energy budget; incompatible arrays and unknown designs need study rather than automatic improvement. Costs 30 Mana on commitment.

Workshop of the Singing Tools.name: Workshop of the Singing Tools
Workshop of the Singing Tools.description: Charm several real workshop tools to follow a simple demonstrated sequence while you supervise for an hour. Materials, power, safe programming and your actual craft knowledge still determine the resulting work. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

Regalia of One Promise.name: Regalia of One Promise
Regalia of One Promise.description: Prepare a temporary linked enchantment across a small willing group's actual equipment for one expedition scene. Choose one narrow shared support, such as steadier grips or weather sealing; the bond offers no telepathy, command or multiplied attack count. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

The Name Beneath the Steel.name: The Name Beneath the Steel
The Name Beneath the Steel.description: During a substantial workshop project inscribe a durable, specific enchantment into one suitable real item. Materials, blueprint, tests and the item's supported bonuses must be resolved; a described design is not a completed artifact. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

Thousandfold Artisan's Oath.name: Thousandfold Artisan's Oath
Thousandfold Artisan's Oath.description: Coordinate a complex temporary enchantment over a prepared working site for a major single operation. Choose one engineering purpose and supply its real tools, materials and power; the working enables a project rather than universally improving every skill or creating limitless items. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

Pocket Courier.name: Pocket Courier
Pocket Courier.description: Call a tiny temporary mothlike familiar within reach for a minute to carry one light object a few metres while you watch. It follows simple commands, has no shared omniscient senses and cannot attack independently. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Little Lantern Guest.name: Little Lantern Guest
Little Lantern Guest.description: Call a small harmless luminous wisp beside you for ten minutes. It follows you and lights a short path, occupying your active summon attention without granting scouting knowledge beyond what you actually perceive. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

First Fang Invitation.name: First Fang Invitation
First Fang Invitation.description: Call one small temporary beast-shaped familiar into a visible free space within 3 metres for two exchanges. Directing a bite uses your action and an actual combat resolution; the appearance alone grants no species mastery or extra turn. Costs 5 Mana on commitment.

Porter's Gentle Visitor.name: Porter's Gentle Visitor
Porter's Gentle Visitor.description: Call a knee-high load-bearing familiar for a scene to carry a modest real parcel along an open route beside you. It needs your guidance and cannot pass locked doors, fly without an established form or carry unlimited weight. Costs 5 Mana on commitment.

Wick Salamander.name: Wick Salamander
Wick Salamander.description: Call a small Fire Elemental into a visible safe space within 5 metres for two exchanges. It can tend a flame or deliver one commanded close attack on your action; it shares the hazards and limits of its actual form. Costs 6 Mana on commitment.

Raincup Companion.name: Raincup Companion
Raincup Companion.description: Call a small Water Elemental beside you for a minute to help wash, carry a little water or press one nearby opening. It creates no permanent drinking supply and any attack uses your command action. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Stonepaw Guard.name: Stonepaw Guard
Stonepaw Guard.description: Call a compact Earth Elemental to hold one nearby approach for two exchanges. A commanded block or strike uses your action, with its actual position and durability tracked rather than granting automatic protection. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Ribbonwing Scout.name: Ribbonwing Scout
Ribbonwing Scout.description: Call a small winged familiar to follow one visible route up to 20 metres and return. You receive simple behaviour or signals on its return, not unrestricted live remote vision, a complete map or knowledge through sealed barriers. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Familiar's Safe Recall.name: Familiar's Safe Recall
Familiar's Safe Recall.description: Recall one of your actual temporary summons from within 20 metres and dismiss its body safely if the attempt succeeds. It does not retrieve carried contraband through wards, restore a dead real companion or refund its casting cost. Costs 12 Mana on commitment.

Pactkeeper's Invitation.name: Pactkeeper's Invitation
Pactkeeper's Invitation.description: Offer a clear temporary service pact to one present intelligent spirit or summon. The entity may accept, bargain or refuse; the spell clarifies the agreed limits without compelling a soul or inventing prior consent. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Windcourser Call.name: Windcourser Call
Windcourser Call.description: Call a Wind Elemental shaped for one willing rider across a clear ground route for a scene. Its support needs your attention and real landing space; flight, combat and additional passengers require separate appropriate workings. Costs 14 Mana on commitment.

Twin Visitor Accord.name: Twin Visitor Accord
Twin Visitor Accord.description: Call two modest temporary familiars into adjacent visible spaces for three exchanges. You may direct them together toward one shared task or resolved attack each action, never gaining two independent full turns. Costs 24 Mana on commitment.

Frostward Guest.name: Frostward Guest
Frostward Guest.description: Call an Ice Elemental capable of holding a narrow nearby lane for three exchanges. Give it one deliberate order each action; actual movement, defence and attacks are resolved without turning its presence into free damage. Costs 28 Mana on commitment.

Brass Guardian Invitation.name: Brass Guardian Invitation
Brass Guardian Invitation.description: Call a temporary articulated metal guardian into a clear space within 8 metres for a scene. It follows simple visible commands and needs your action to fight; its temporary body yields no permanent metal or crafted equipment. Costs 30 Mana on commitment.

Menagerie Procession.name: Menagerie Procession
Menagerie Procession.description: Call up to three distinct modest temporary familiars for a coordinated task during one scene. Divide attention and actual capabilities between them; the group still performs one commanded combat action per exchange rather than becoming an army. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

Great Elemental Audience.name: Great Elemental Audience
Great Elemental Audience.description: Call one large elemental whose discipline and purpose you have actually studied into a prepared clear site. It remains for three exchanges under active command, with dangerous resistance or dismissal if control fails; summoning does not grant every elemental spell. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

Guardian at the Long Gate.name: Guardian at the Long Gate
Guardian at the Long Gate.description: Prepare and call one formidable temporary guardian to a surveyed defended site for a short battle. Its type, position, Health and command limits must be established in the scene; it is a real combat participant, not an invincible narrative obstacle. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

The Court of Returning Guests.name: The Court of Returning Guests
The Court of Returning Guests.description: Prepare an exceptional coordinated calling of up to three established willing or controlled summons for a single major task. Respect their actual agreements and combined command budget; legendary dragons, independent people and unknown spirits cannot simply be claimed as possessions. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

Paper Butterfly Lie.name: Paper Butterfly Lie
Paper Butterfly Lie.description: Create a palm-sized moving visual image within 3 metres for a minute. It can amuse or draw attention, but has no substance, heat or sound and is exposed by touch. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Borrowed Footfall.name: Borrowed Footfall
Borrowed Footfall.description: Place the sound of one plausible footstep at a point within 5 metres you can perceive. It can distract a listener without forcing belief, moving a creature or fabricating a whole conversation. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Sweetened Expectation.name: Sweetened Expectation
Sweetened Expectation.description: Alter the perceived flavour of one touched serving for a willing taster for a few bites. The food's nutrition, toxins and ingredients remain real; an illusion is no cure for spoiled or dangerous food. Costs 5 Mana on commitment.

Chalkboard Double.name: Chalkboard Double
Chalkboard Double.description: Place a static visual image of a page, sign or seated figure within 8 metres for two exchanges. Inspection, touch and inconsistencies can reveal it, and it changes no real grades, records or attendance state. Costs 6 Mana on commitment.

Voice Behind the Curtain.name: Voice Behind the Curtain
Voice Behind the Curtain.description: Project a short plausible sound or a voice you can actually imitate from a perceived point within 10 metres. Accuracy and listeners' knowledge determine credibility; it is no automatic impersonation of authority. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Mirrorstep Afterimage.name: Mirrorstep Afterimage
Mirrorstep Afterimage.description: Leave a brief visual afterimage along a real movement up to 3 metres. It can complicate one enemy's aim, but your body still follows a real path and opponents may track you by other senses. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Borrowed Uniform.name: Borrowed Uniform
Borrowed Uniform.description: Overlay a simple visual clothing disguise on yourself for a scene. It changes appearance rather than shape, voice, documents or actual faction membership, and close inspection can expose mismatches. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

False Opening.name: False Opening
False Opening.description: Show one plausible exposed gap on your own guard for an exchange, then attempt to exploit an opponent's response. Their judgment and perception still decide whether the bait works; the illusion supplies no free counterattack. Costs 12 Mana on commitment.

Faintly Familiar Face.name: Faintly Familiar Face
Faintly Familiar Face.description: Soften recognition of your visible features with a plausible alternate face for a scene. Species proportions and actual voice remain relevant, and memories or established relationships are not rewritten. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Hallway Rehearsal.name: Hallway Rehearsal
Hallway Rehearsal.description: Create a short repeated visual and audible scene across a five-metre space for two exchanges. It may distract or mislead people who have a reason to believe it, while physical interaction and contradictions remain revealing. Costs 14 Mana on commitment.

Stage of Three Doubles.name: Stage of Three Doubles
Stage of Three Doubles.description: Place three visual doubles around your real position within 10 metres for two exchanges. They mimic your broad movement but cannot strike, block a path or multiply your actions. Costs 24 Mana on commitment.

Quiet Banquet Masquerade.name: Quiet Banquet Masquerade
Quiet Banquet Masquerade.description: Overlay a coherent set of minor sights and sounds over a prepared five-metre social space for a scene. Observers can notice errors, and food, injury, ownership and recorded transactions remain unchanged. Costs 26 Mana on commitment.

Labyrinth of Familiar Doors.name: Labyrinth of Familiar Doors
Labyrinth of Familiar Doors.description: Alter the apparent details of several visible doorways within 15 metres for two exchanges. People may choose a wrong real route if deceived; it creates no real passage and opens no locked door. Costs 30 Mana on commitment.

Phantom Cavalcade.name: Phantom Cavalcade
Phantom Cavalcade.description: Send a large coordinated visual and audible charge across a twenty-metre visible lane. It can pressure decisions through a credible deception, with no physical impact and an actual chance for observers to recognize the trick. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

The Room Remembers Otherwise.name: The Room Remembers Otherwise
The Room Remembers Otherwise.description: Recreate the sensory appearance of a room you have genuinely studied over a similar prepared space for a scene. This is a staged imitation, not evidence that its portrayed history happened or a means to change memory. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

Festival of the Untrue Moon.name: Festival of the Untrue Moon
Festival of the Untrue Moon.description: Shape a vivid multisensory illusion over a fifteen-metre site for three exchanges, with consistent lighting, sound and surface impressions. Real collisions and independent investigation still reveal the staging; subjects keep their choices and beliefs. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

The Last Curtain Rises.name: The Last Curtain Rises
The Last Curtain Rises.description: Construct an intricate temporary sensory performance around a prepared twenty-metre site using two exchanges of visible concentration. It can convincingly conceal one staged operation if unchallenged, without mind control, physical barriers or rewriting world state. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

Glint of the Obvious.name: Glint of the Obvious
Glint of the Obvious.description: Focus on one visible object within reach and notice a small immediately observable detail you might otherwise miss. It supports examination, not secret identification, remote knowledge or a guaranteed answer to an investigation. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Wavering Omen.name: Wavering Omen
Wavering Omen.description: Ask a narrow question about one immediate risky action you can actually attempt. Receive an uncertain impression of a nearby hazard if the reading succeeds; the future can change and a vague impression is not proof. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Trail of the Last Touch.name: Trail of the Last Touch
Trail of the Last Touch.description: Examine a touched object for a faint recent magical disturbance. You may sense that contact or casting occurred, without learning a stranger's name, exact actions or a complete history. Costs 5 Mana on commitment.

Second Glance.name: Second Glance
Second Glance.description: Compare one immediate sensory impression with a fresh reading for signs of magical inconsistency. A successful check can raise a specific doubt about an illusion, but does not automatically dispel it or expose every secret. Costs 5 Mana on commitment.

Footfall Before the Turn.name: Footfall Before the Turn
Footfall Before the Turn.description: Read a nearby moving creature's visible rhythm to anticipate one likely next step within 8 metres. It supports a deliberate response, while feints, unfamiliar movement and changed choices can defeat the prediction. Costs 6 Mana on commitment.

Compass of the Familiar.name: Compass of the Familiar
Compass of the Familiar.description: Seek a rough direction toward one personally studied nearby object whose identifying token you hold. Distance, wards and similar objects can distort the reading; it grants no exact route or authority to take the object. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Ashes Speak Softly.name: Ashes Speak Softly
Ashes Speak Softly.description: Read a touched recent trace for a fragmentary impression of the force that made it. The result is a clue shaped by the actual trace, not a narrated eyewitness account or an invented culprit. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Eyes on the Threshold.name: Eyes on the Threshold
Eyes on the Threshold.description: Inspect one visible doorway or short route for immediate signs of a magical hazard over an exchange. You may notice a suspicious pattern; hidden mundane traps and stronger concealment still need actual investigation. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Moment's Weight.name: Moment's Weight
Moment's Weight.description: Concentrate on an observed opponent for one exchange, then assess their likely commitment to one immediate manoeuvre. It informs your next choice without reading thoughts or guaranteeing a perfect counter. Costs 12 Mana on commitment.

Thread of a Known Voice.name: Thread of a Known Voice
Thread of a Known Voice.description: Use a genuine personal token to seek a faint nearby impression of a familiar willing person. Their consent, actual range and wards matter; the spell cannot locate every missing stranger across realms. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Waterglass Retrospect.name: Waterglass Retrospect
Waterglass Retrospect.description: Read one touched site for a brief fragmentary echo of a significant recent magical event. The echo can omit context and reflects only what the site retained, requiring corroboration before accusations or conclusions. Costs 14 Mana on commitment.

Starpath Survey.name: Starpath Survey
Starpath Survey.description: Compare visible landmarks and magical currents to estimate a safe route through an existing surveyed area. This aids navigation while weather, altered paths and unknown threats can invalidate the reading. Costs 24 Mana on commitment.

Oracle's Measured Answer.name: Oracle's Measured Answer
Oracle's Measured Answer.description: Spend several quiet minutes on one specific near-future choice with known stakes. Receive a conditional possibility or meaningful uncertainty rather than a guaranteed prophecy, required player decision or new Time power. Costs 28 Mana on commitment.

Glass of Distant Courtesy.name: Glass of Distant Courtesy
Glass of Distant Courtesy.description: Attempt a brief remote observation of a personally known willing subject or surveyed existing place through a real sympathetic focus. Permission, wards and actual conditions can limit or block the view; this does not create knowledge of unseen rooms. Costs 30 Mana on commitment.

Witness of the Broken Sigil.name: Witness of the Broken Sigil
Witness of the Broken Sigil.description: Reconstruct fragments of a major magical event from its real surviving traces during a careful investigation. Distinguish observations from interpretation, and preserve gaps rather than inventing a complete authoritative history. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

Constellation of Falling Blades.name: Constellation of Falling Blades
Constellation of Falling Blades.description: Read several visible hostile movement patterns within 15 metres for two exchanges. It helps choose defensive positioning but divides attention and grants neither omniscience nor automatic dodges against every attack. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

The Unchosen Road.name: The Unchosen Road
The Unchosen Road.description: Conduct a protected divination project concerning one major approaching decision. Reveal several plausible conditional outcomes grounded in existing facts, retaining uncertainty and others' agency; visions do not lock the story or move time. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

Eyes at the Edge of Dawn.name: Eyes at the Edge of Dawn
Eyes at the Edge of Dawn.description: Focus a master-level reading on a surveyed region's significant magical disturbance with real evidence and preparation. Gain bounded clues to its likely course rather than complete knowledge, exact enemy plans or the ability to alter the past or future. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

Spiritward Thread.name: Spiritward Thread
Spiritward Thread.description: Trace a small temporary ward on yourself or one willing touched creature for two exchanges. It contests a minor external spiritual intrusion without granting universal immunity, harming an ordinary soul or draining personal Mana. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Mourning Lantern.name: Mourning Lantern
Mourning Lantern.description: Raise a dim spiritual light within reach for a minute that may react to nearby unshielded lingering spirits. A reaction suggests presence, not identity or guilt, and the light neither summons the dead nor reads minds. Costs 3 Mana on commitment.

Gravehand Rattle.name: Gravehand Rattle
Gravehand Rattle.description: Animate a few unattended loose bones into one small temporary grasp within 3 metres for an exchange. No conscious soul is called; the grasp uses your action and real bones, then falls apart when the working ends. Costs 5 Mana on commitment.

Guest at the Threshold.name: Guest at the Threshold
Guest at the Threshold.description: Offer a brief means of communication to one present willing spirit that can understand you. It may refuse, lie or lack the answer; the invitation does not call any named dead person into existence. Costs 5 Mana on commitment.

Restless Thread Nudge.name: Restless Thread Nudge
Restless Thread Nudge.description: Push against one visible minor possessing influence within 5 metres while protecting its host. Exorcism is contested and demands identification; the host's ordinary emotions, species or disagreement are not possession. Costs 6 Mana on commitment.

Bone Porter.name: Bone Porter
Bone Porter.description: Animate a small available set of remains for simple carrying work beside you for a scene. It contains no conscious deceased soul, has only the body's real capabilities and cannot fight without your deliberate command action. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Circle of Kindly Rest.name: Circle of Kindly Rest
Circle of Kindly Rest.description: Set a two-metre temporary ward around actual remains during a burial or examination. It contests minor intrusive animation while preserving the ability to inspect respectfully, with no guarantee against a stronger necromancer. Costs 8 Mana on commitment.

Ghosttouch Needle.name: Ghosttouch Needle
Ghosttouch Needle.description: Deliver a focused spiritual strike at one perceived incorporeal hostile entity within 10 metres. It requires an actual target and combat resolution, leaving ordinary people unharmed unless a separate physical effect is established. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Echo Kept in Glass.name: Echo Kept in Glass
Echo Kept in Glass.description: Preserve one willing present spirit's brief message in a prepared vessel for later playback. Consent and the actual message matter; this stores an echo rather than imprisoning the speaker's conscious soul. Costs 12 Mana on commitment.

Borrowed Bones Sentinel.name: Borrowed Bones Sentinel
Borrowed Bones Sentinel.description: Animate one available humanoid-sized skeleton to hold a nearby post for two exchanges. No conscious soul is summoned; one commanded block or attack uses your action, and damage to the real remains is tracked. Costs 10 Mana on commitment.

Gentle Hand of Exile.name: Gentle Hand of Exile
Gentle Hand of Exile.description: Attempt to expel one identified external possessing spirit from a living host through a focused exchange. The spirit resists and the host must actually be protected; success removes that influence without automatically healing its injuries. Costs 14 Mana on commitment.

Pact of the Candlelit Guest.name: Pact of the Candlelit Guest
Pact of the Candlelit Guest.description: Negotiate a limited service with one present conscious spirit inside a prepared circle. State its consent, term and boundaries before any service; an agreement is no resurrection, ownership of the dead or automatic obedience. Costs 24 Mana on commitment.

Ossuary Procession.name: Ossuary Procession
Ossuary Procession.description: Animate up to three available sets of modest remains for a scene under a shared command. None contains a conscious soul, and their coordinated combat effort consumes your action rather than producing three independent turns. Costs 28 Mana on commitment.

Name Against the Haunting.name: Name Against the Haunting
Name Against the Haunting.description: Use genuine evidence of a particular haunting to contest its attachment to one existing site. A protected ritual can release or weaken that bond, while a wrong explanation or strong resisting entity can defeat the attempt. Costs 30 Mana on commitment.

Pale Warden's Covenant.name: Pale Warden's Covenant
Pale Warden's Covenant.description: Invite one willing conscious guardian spirit to defend a prepared place under an explicit short agreement. Its actual capabilities and choices remain intact, and it cannot be invented as a convenient legendary ally or forced into permanent service. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

Sever the Stolen Reins.name: Sever the Stolen Reins
Sever the Stolen Reins.description: Attempt to break an observed necromantic control bond while protecting any conscious spirit involved. Success ends that specific control rather than killing its controller, freeing every undead creature or claiming command for yourself. Costs 40 Mana on commitment.

Hall of the Unburied Names.name: Hall of the Unburied Names
Hall of the Unburied Names.description: Conduct a protected rite to invite several locally present willing dead to speak in turn about an actual unresolved history. Each knows only their own memories and may refuse; the rite supplies witnesses, not a complete true account or new corpses. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

The Last Bell of Release.name: The Last Bell of Release
The Last Bell of Release.description: Prepare a master-level exorcism against one established powerful spiritual attachment using its real anchors and history. Resolve a difficult contest over two exposed exchanges or a longer protected rite; release is possible, but resurrection, soul extraction and temporal reversal are not implied. Costs 55 Mana on commitment.

Hammering Entry.name: Hammering Entry
Hammering Entry.description: Commit your body behind one heavy blow with a trained weapon or bare hand. A firm stance can drive a guard backward on a successful hit, while a missed commitment leaves room for a response. Costs 3 Stamina on commitment.

Shoulder Through.name: Shoulder Through
Shoulder Through.description: Drive a controlled shoulder or shield into one nearby obstruction or opponent. Leverage, relative mass and footing decide whether you clear a little space; this is one forceful action rather than a strike plus a free grapple. Costs 3 Stamina on commitment.

Anvil Grip.name: Anvil Grip
Anvil Grip.description: Clamp a trained hold on one contacted limb or weapon and use your body weight to contest its motion. Establish the grip first; a stronger position, pain or a counter can break it. Costs 4 Stamina on commitment.

Low Gate Sweep.name: Low Gate Sweep
Low Gate Sweep.description: Sweep a leg, staff or suitable weapon through an exposed nearby base. It can topple an overcommitted opponent on a successful contest, with your own balance vulnerable if they read the attempt. Costs 4 Stamina on commitment.

Cracking Post.name: Cracking Post
Cracking Post.description: Strike one exposed brace, shield edge or joint with focused heavy force. The real material and support decide what breaks; this is no automatic destruction of armour, enchantments or living bones. Costs 5 Stamina on commitment.

Bear's Short Clinch.name: Bear's Short Clinch
Bear's Short Clinch.description: Close into a tight clinch and use a trained turn to restrict one opponent's striking room. Position and resistance determine control, and maintaining or improving the hold takes your continued effort. Costs 5 Stamina on commitment.

Red Gate Rush.name: Red Gate Rush
Red Gate Rush.description: Charge along a clear path up to 5 metres into one committed close attack. Footing, obstacles and the opponent's response matter, and the movement does not also grant a second normal attack. Costs 6 Stamina on commitment.

Bellringer's Lift.name: Bellringer's Lift
Bellringer's Lift.description: Use an established grip to lift and turn one manageable opponent or heavy object. Resolve the throw or relocation honestly against mass, leverage and resistance, with an actual clear landing rather than an automatic stun. Costs 6 Stamina on commitment.

Quarry Splitter.name: Quarry Splitter
Quarry Splitter.description: Deliver a full-body strike into a known weak point of a hard target. Sound structure, armour and a moving defender still resist; spotting the weakness is part of the setup rather than guaranteed by the name. Costs 7 Stamina on commitment.

Iron Door Reversal.name: Iron Door Reversal
Iron Door Reversal.description: Meet a forceful close approach with an anchored pivot and shove it off line. This resolves one defensive reversal, not an automatic counterattack after a free block. Costs 7 Stamina on commitment.

Falling Millstone.name: Falling Millstone
Falling Millstone.description: Drop your weight through a powerful downward blow from a real supported step or short fall. The committed impact can threaten a strong guard, while avoiding the line leaves you recovering from the heavy finish. Costs 8 Stamina on commitment.

Gatebreaker Spiral.name: Gatebreaker Spiral
Gatebreaker Spiral.description: Use a broad controlled weapon or body sweep to force nearby attackers to give ground. Resolve the sweep once across actual reach, including obstacles and allies rather than hitting everyone around you without aim. Costs 9 Stamina on commitment.

Colossus Under the Arch.name: Colossus Under the Arch
Colossus Under the Arch.description: Brace against a heavy falling or advancing load long enough for a nearby escape. Real support, scale and your condition decide how long you can hold; the feat does not make you immovable or restore Stamina. Costs 10 Stamina on commitment.

Thunder Without Magic.name: Thunder Without Magic
Thunder Without Magic.description: Commit an explosive close strike using exceptional trained power and whole-body timing. Its force can overwhelm a poorly supported defence, but it remains a physical hit with reach, resistance and recovery. Costs 11 Stamina on commitment.

Mountainbreaker Descent.name: Mountainbreaker Descent
Mountainbreaker Descent.description: Use a real elevation, anchor and trained weapon to deliver a tremendous downward strike at one reachable target. Prepare the line and accept the landing; this creates no magical shockwave or unavoidable area damage. Costs 13 Stamina on commitment.

The Last Gate Falls.name: The Last Gate Falls
The Last Gate Falls.description: Put a master's full strength and leverage into one decisive breach, throw or finishing blow. State the target and supported position first; a failed commitment spends the effort and leaves a real opening rather than guaranteeing a kill. Costs 15 Stamina on commitment.

Needle Opening.name: Needle Opening
Needle Opening.description: Make one precise attack at a visible gap using a trained light weapon or unarmed technique. Timing improves the opportunity, while armour coverage, reach and the defender's movement still matter. Costs 3 Stamina on commitment.

Slipping Measure.name: Slipping Measure
Slipping Measure.description: Take a short economical sidestep to spoil one incoming line while keeping a useful stance. You need actual space and awareness; it grants no automatic dodge or extra counterattack. Costs 3 Stamina on commitment.

Ribbon Feint.name: Ribbon Feint
Ribbon Feint.description: Offer a convincing false line and redirect your next committed attack within the same exchange. The opponent may read or ignore the bait, and the whole manoeuvre remains one attack action. Costs 4 Stamina on commitment.

Flick of the Empty Hand.name: Flick of the Empty Hand
Flick of the Empty Hand.description: Use a quick trained touch to knock a loose item or poorly supported weapon off line. A secured grip or experienced response can defeat the attempt; you do not acquire ownership merely by disarming someone. Costs 4 Stamina on commitment.

Heelturn Cut.name: Heelturn Cut
Heelturn Cut.description: Pivot around a close attack and commit a short returning strike as one manoeuvre. Position, timing and a clear path decide success rather than combining a guaranteed defence with a guaranteed hit. Costs 5 Stamina on commitment.

Thread Between Blades.name: Thread Between Blades
Thread Between Blades.description: Slip through one visible opening between nearby threats to a real point up to 3 metres away. The path is contested movement, not teleportation, and hazards along it still apply. Costs 5 Stamina on commitment.

Glass Needle Draw.name: Glass Needle Draw
Glass Needle Draw.description: Draw a properly carried familiar weapon directly into one precise close attack. The weapon must actually be available and ready; surprise depends on the scene rather than being guaranteed by the quick draw. Costs 6 Stamina on commitment.

Sparrow's Change of Branch.name: Sparrow's Change of Branch
Sparrow's Change of Branch.description: Redirect a leap or fast approach toward a nearby real foothold. Your trained footwork can rescue a compromised angle, with landing, load and available space still resolved honestly. Costs 6 Stamina on commitment.

Wrist and Whisper.name: Wrist and Whisper
Wrist and Whisper.description: Threaten a delicate exposed grip point to force a disarm contest. Choose the weapon hand or fitting you can actually reach; success does not also inflict a full separate damaging strike. Costs 7 Stamina on commitment.

Threefold False Invitation.name: Threefold False Invitation
Threefold False Invitation.description: Chain several compact feints into one committed final line. The pattern can draw an opponent out of a disciplined guard, but repetition, reach and their perception can spoil the sequence. Costs 7 Stamina on commitment.

Moonlit Passing Cut.name: Moonlit Passing Cut
Moonlit Passing Cut.description: Move past one opponent along a clear short lane and make a single passing strike. You must win the approach and leave a real exit; the technique offers no untouchable movement or free return attack. Costs 8 Stamina on commitment.

Needle Through the Ring.name: Needle Through the Ring
Needle Through the Ring.description: Place one exceptional precision strike through a genuinely observed moving gap. Concealed armour, false openings and poor visibility remain meaningful, and the move never invents an internal target you cannot reach. Costs 9 Stamina on commitment.

Dance on the Broken Floor.name: Dance on the Broken Floor
Dance on the Broken Floor.description: Traverse a short hazardous footing sequence using visible stable contacts and exceptional balance. This can gain position under pressure, but weak supports and incoming attacks remain real obstacles rather than scenery. Costs 10 Stamina on commitment.

The Uncaught Sleeve.name: The Uncaught Sleeve
The Uncaught Sleeve.description: Escape one established physical hold through trained timing, joint positioning and a narrow movement. Size, injury and the captor's actual leverage contest the escape; restraints are not magically dissolved. Costs 11 Stamina on commitment.

Seven Shadows, One Blade.name: Seven Shadows, One Blade
Seven Shadows, One Blade.description: Use a dazzling sequence of rapid real feints and footwork to deliver one final precise attack. Observers may struggle to follow it, but there are no duplicates, teleports or seven independent hits. Costs 13 Stamina on commitment.

The Smallest Possible Victory.name: The Smallest Possible Victory
The Smallest Possible Victory.description: Exploit one genuine momentary opening with a master's economical finishing technique. Identify the reachable opening and commit once; a successful result can be decisive without promising unavoidable death or bypassing every defence. Costs 15 Stamina on commitment.

Wagonwall Advance.name: Wagonwall Advance
Wagonwall Advance.description: Move a few deliberate steps while maintaining a trained shield, weapon or body guard. This can escort one nearby willing ally through a threatened line, with pace, space and actual protection limiting the advance. Costs 8 Stamina on commitment.

The Hinge Refuses.name: The Hinge Refuses
The Hinge Refuses.description: Anchor a close defence against one powerful incoming shove or blow. Choose the line you can actually meet; flanking, damaged footing and overwhelming force can break the stance. Costs 8 Stamina on commitment.

Lanterns Under the Shield.name: Lanterns Under the Shield
Lanterns Under the Shield.description: Cover two nearby willing allies against one broad visible threat using real reach and terrain. Protection is shared and contested, not full immunity for everyone or a free retaliatory attack. Costs 9 Stamina on commitment.

Steel Rain Shelter.name: Steel Rain Shelter
Steel Rain Shelter.description: Use a suitable shield or weapon and available cover to weather one concentrated volley. The angle, projectile force and coverage decide what is stopped; defending the front leaves other lines exposed. Costs 10 Stamina on commitment.

Gatekeeper's Turning Hour.name: Gatekeeper's Turning Hour
Gatekeeper's Turning Hour.description: Pivot a defended close lane so an advancing opponent must choose between a slower approach and a contested exposed angle. This is deliberate positional defence, not compulsory movement or universal crowd control. Costs 10 Stamina on commitment.

Hold Until the Bell.name: Hold Until the Bell
Hold Until the Bell.description: Commit to holding one narrow real approach through a sustained exchange while allies withdraw. Enemy reach, pressure and your condition determine success, and the effort cannot keep every attack away from every ally. Costs 11 Stamina on commitment.

A Place the Storm Cannot Take.name: A Place the Storm Cannot Take
A Place the Storm Cannot Take.description: Make a masterful anchored defence of a small real shelter against one overwhelming physical threat. Supports and your actual equipment must bear the force; the stance does not make the shelter invulnerable or cancel unrelated magic. Costs 13 Stamina on commitment.

The Last Person Through.name: The Last Person Through
The Last Person Through.description: Take the most exposed position in an organized retreat and contest the immediate threat long enough for nearby companions to pass. Your own exit remains a real tactical problem, with no guaranteed survival or automatic relocation. Costs 15 Stamina on commitment.

Name the Exit.name: Name the Exit
Name the Exit.description: Identify and clearly call one real nearby escape route using what you can actually see. Allies choose whether to follow; the call grants neither free movement nor knowledge of a hidden safe passage. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Count the Hands.name: Count the Hands
Count the Hands.description: Spend an exchange watching the visible opposition's held equipment and current formation. Report a concrete vulnerability or uncertainty, with concealed weapons and misinformation still able to defeat the assessment. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

One Clear Order.name: One Clear Order
One Clear Order.description: Give a willing nearby ally one concise practical instruction grounded in the current situation. It can improve coordination if understood, without compelling obedience or granting an extra action. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Trade Places Cleanly.name: Trade Places Cleanly
Trade Places Cleanly.description: Coordinate a short real position exchange with one willing adjacent ally. Both need a usable route and their actual movement; the manoeuvre cannot teleport either participant or erase threats crossing the path. Costs 3 Stamina on commitment.

Borrow the Doorway.name: Borrow the Doorway
Borrow the Doorway.description: Use a real narrow approach to limit how many visible opponents can reach the group at once. Securing the position takes action and opponents can flank, break cover or refuse the approach. Costs 3 Stamina on commitment.

Watch the Second Hand.name: Watch the Second Hand
Watch the Second Hand.description: Focus attention on an observed enemy's support movement, seeking the cue that precedes their next commitment. It provides a bounded tactical read rather than certainty about hidden abilities or the future. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Two Beats Apart.name: Two Beats Apart
Two Beats Apart.description: Coordinate the timing of willing allies' already available actions so they pressure one observed opening together. Every ally still spends their own action and resources; this never duplicates their attack or guarantees the sequence. Costs 4 Stamina on commitment.

Turn the Furniture.name: Turn the Furniture
Turn the Furniture.description: Rearrange reachable real cover into a better immediate defensive position. Available time, weight and incoming pressure limit the work; the plan creates no furniture or finished fortification from nothing. Costs 4 Stamina on commitment.

Leave Them a Road.name: Leave Them a Road
Leave Them a Road.description: Offer an actual visible withdrawal lane to encourage a pressured opponent to disengage. Their motives and judgment decide whether they take it, and using the lane does not make them a recruited ally. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Cut the Relay.name: Cut the Relay
Cut the Relay.description: Identify and act against one observed enemy communication or supply link using actual reach and tools. The interruption can disrupt coordination, but knowledge of a link is not automatic access to its hidden endpoints. Costs 5 Stamina on commitment.

Feigned Collapse.name: Feigned Collapse
Feigned Collapse.description: Coordinate a plausible short retreat with informed willing allies to draw enemies toward a real prepared position. Participants spend real movement and effort, and opponents may recognize the bait or decline pursuit. Costs 5 Stamina on commitment.

The Quiet Reserve.name: The Quiet Reserve
The Quiet Reserve.description: Keep one willing ally or prepared resource ready for a specific visible contingency. Waiting has a real opportunity cost and does not create an extra reaction, summon or resource when the contingency arrives. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Crossfire Courtesy.name: Crossfire Courtesy
Crossfire Courtesy.description: Set compatible firing or attack lanes for willing allies through a surveyed immediate space. Their own aim, actions and targets still resolve individually, with no friendly-fire immunity or shared omniscience. Costs 6 Stamina on commitment.

Fold the Front.name: Fold the Front
Fold the Front.description: Direct an organized group manoeuvre against one observed weak point while maintaining a real retreat lane. Communication, space and each participant's actions remain necessary; the plan does not move the entire party for free. Costs 7 Stamina on commitment.

Every Lantern Accounted For.name: Every Lantern Accounted For
Every Lantern Accounted For.description: Coordinate a difficult evacuation through an actual surveyed route, assigning clear jobs and checking who remains. Time, injuries and pursuit are real constraints, and unseen people are not automatically located or rescued. Costs 8 Stamina on commitment.

The Battle Has Another Door.name: The Battle Has Another Door
The Battle Has Another Door.description: Read a complex visible battle and commit the group to one feasible decisive change of objective or position. The plan can create a major opportunity through real actions, without scripting victory, controlling allies or revealing secret enemy plans. Costs 10 Stamina on commitment.

Circuit Tap.name: Circuit Tap
Circuit Tap.description: Inspect an accessible real mana circuit with suitable tools for a loose contact or obvious interruption. The check can locate a simple fault without repairing unknown technology, restoring charges or granting a finished device. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Safe Bleed Valve.name: Safe Bleed Valve
Safe Bleed Valve.description: Use an accessible designed discharge point to vent a small unstable device safely with proper tools. Actual charge is lost rather than transferred into your personal Mana, and an unknown or damaged system can resist safe handling. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Focus Seating.name: Focus Seating
Focus Seating.description: Reseat a compatible loose component in a real casting focus during a careful working interval. Correct tools and a known design are required; broken parts, absent material and spells the user never learned remain separate problems. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Insulated Bypass.name: Insulated Bypass
Insulated Bypass.description: Build a temporary bypass around one identified simple circuit fault using real suitable wire and insulation. The repair needs testing, consumes actual materials and cannot safely bridge every damaged high-power system. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Charged-Line Probe.name: Charged-Line Probe
Charged-Line Probe.description: Use a proper real probe to trace power through an exposed section of a known device. Isolate dangerous loads before touching them; the technique reveals a circuit's response rather than hidden passwords or all its functions. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Bench-Side Stabilizer.name: Bench-Side Stabilizer
Bench-Side Stabilizer.description: Rig a temporary brace or regulator on a known malfunctioning device with actual suitable parts. It can buy time for proper repair, with ongoing load and a failed test still posing a real risk. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Quickrelease Housing.name: Quickrelease Housing
Quickrelease Housing.description: Fit or activate a prepared mechanical quickrelease on your actual equipment under pressure. It can discard a snagged pack or damaged fitting, but the dropped item remains where it falls and cannot be recovered by declaration. Costs 3 Stamina on commitment.

Courier Circuit Pair.name: Courier Circuit Pair
Courier Circuit Pair.description: Calibrate a real compatible pair of short-range signalling devices during a working session. Messages depend on their actual power, range and connection; this creates neither free devices nor unrestricted telepathy. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Reserve Cell Assay.name: Reserve Cell Assay
Reserve Cell Assay.description: Test a real external mana cell's usable charge and safe output with suitable equipment. Record the actual result; knowledge of the reserve grants no personal Mana, invented capacity or automatic full recharge. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Field Housing Patch.name: Field Housing Patch
Field Housing Patch.description: Repair a known device's damaged ordinary housing using actual available tools and material. It restores protection when the work succeeds, while internal faults, enchantments and missing components need their own repair. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Prepared Snare Release.name: Prepared Snare Release
Prepared Snare Release.description: Deploy a real previously built mechanical snare in a reachable prepared position. Its actual design and placement determine the restraint; it consumes or commits that device and does not conjure traps or bypass a target's resistance. Costs 4 Stamina on commitment.

Mana Rail Alignment.name: Mana Rail Alignment
Mana Rail Alignment.description: Align a real powered device's known distribution rails to handle its intended load more reliably. A working interval, suitable instruments and real tests are required; the tune grants no new spell or limitless efficiency. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Shield Emitter Triage.name: Shield Emitter Triage
Shield Emitter Triage.description: Stabilize one real shield emitter whose design you know using suitable parts and an accessible safe work point. The device's actual charge and supported protection remain the limit, without creating a new barrier for free. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Workshop Synchrony.name: Workshop Synchrony
Workshop Synchrony.description: Coordinate several real compatible powered tools for one supervised manufacturing operation. Supply the design, material, energy and safety measures; automated motion does not grant unknown craft knowledge or unattended limitless production. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Heart of the Walking Engine.name: Heart of the Walking Engine
Heart of the Walking Engine.description: Diagnose and rebuild one known complex mana-powered mechanism during a substantial workshop project. Real components, power tests and actual engineering knowledge determine success, and a functioning construct gains no invented conscious soul. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

The Machine Learns Its Name.name: The Machine Learns Its Name
The Machine Learns Its Name.description: Design and commission a major integrated magitech device through a real engineering project with tested subsystems and actual materials. Spellcraft is also required if its magical blueprint is new or substantially redesigned; this technique grants neither an instant artifact nor a new spell by itself. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Prismknuckle Entry.name: Prismknuckle Entry
Prismknuckle Entry.description: Wrap a trained fist or heavy weapon in a compact arcane shell and commit one close strike. The shell supports the physical delivery rather than making a second projectile or adding a second full skill total. Costs 8 Mana and 4 Stamina on commitment.

Glass Edge Intercept.name: Glass Edge Intercept
Glass Edge Intercept.description: Shape a short arcane extension along your real guard to catch one approaching line just outside normal reach. It is one timed defence using trained physical delivery; a successful catch grants no free counterattack. Costs 12 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Emberheel Crescent.name: Emberheel Crescent
Emberheel Crescent.description: Sweep a close kick or light weapon through a controlled burning crescent. Resolve the timed strike once, with one-metre extra flame reach and real fuel determining any continuing fire. Costs 10 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Tidemark Draw.name: Tidemark Draw
Tidemark Draw.description: Guide a thin ribbon of water along one precise close strike to hook a guard off line. Contact and footing contest the opening, and the same action supplies no separate unrestricted water attack. Costs 10 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Quarrystone Knuckle.name: Quarrystone Knuckle
Quarrystone Knuckle.description: Sheathe one trained striking surface in temporary stone and commit a heavy close blow. Its weight supports the impact but can slow recovery; the stone fades and the move grants no independent earth projectile. Costs 8 Mana and 4 Stamina on commitment.

Faultline Sentinel.name: Faultline Sentinel
Faultline Sentinel.description: Brace a real close guard with a small raised earth support while meeting one incoming force. Suitable ground, timing and the attack determine protection, with no automatic wall around the whole party. Costs 12 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Galeheel Change.name: Galeheel Change
Galeheel Change.description: Kick a brief gust from your soles to sharpen a short real sidestep or passing strike. Choose movement or the attack as the manoeuvre’s purpose; the gust grants neither flight nor a second action. Costs 8 Mana and 4 Stamina on commitment.

Breakers Under the Palm.name: Breakers Under the Palm
Breakers Under the Palm.description: Drive a trained close palm or heavy weapon into a compact forward gust. Resolve one forceful line up to 3 metres long, with bracing and actual pressure rather than a free physical hit plus a separate spell. Costs 12 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Stormheel Crash.name: Stormheel Crash
Stormheel Crash.description: Land a heavy kick or close weapon blow with a short electrical discharge at its actual contact point. The whole strike resolves once, and insulation, grounding and a missed delivery remain meaningful. Costs 12 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Hoarfrost Parapet.name: Hoarfrost Parapet
Hoarfrost Parapet.description: Grow a brief ice lip from your real shield or grounded guard to meet one incoming line. Correct angle and the temporary ice’s integrity decide protection; this is no full room wall or automatic freezing counter. Costs 12 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Sunblade Salute.name: Sunblade Salute
Sunblade Salute.description: Draw a bright short-lived edge along a trained light weapon and make one precise strike. The glare can complicate reading that line, but sight protection, cover and physical defence still matter. Costs 8 Mana and 4 Stamina on commitment.

Noonday Aegis Turn.name: Noonday Aegis Turn
Noonday Aegis Turn.description: Angle a controlled flash from your real guard while turning one visible approach aside. It supports that defence by spoiling visual aim, with no Healing, physical invulnerability or independent retaliatory beam. Costs 12 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Ironclad Shoulder.name: Ironclad Shoulder
Ironclad Shoulder.description: Form temporary reinforcing plates over a trained shoulder, fist or heavy weapon for one committed collision. The added structure supports a physical shove or strike and disappears afterward instead of becoming free armour. Costs 8 Mana and 4 Stamina on commitment.

Silverhook Riposte.name: Silverhook Riposte
Silverhook Riposte.description: Shape a brief metal hook along a real trained weapon and use it for one timed disarm or returning strike. Choose the purpose before resolving contact; this does not automatically control every metal object nearby. Costs 12 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Bramble Clinch.name: Bramble Clinch
Bramble Clinch.description: Support an established physical clinch with a few temporary hooked vines at its contact points. The combined restraint is one contested manoeuvre, with cutting, strength and positioning offering actual escapes. Costs 10 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Bellknuckle Cross.name: Bellknuckle Cross
Bellknuckle Cross.description: Release a compact resonant burst at the contact point of one trained punch or heavy close strike. The sound intensifies that impact without a second attack roll, automatic deafness or a shockwave through the whole room. Costs 8 Mana and 4 Stamina on commitment.

Quiet Bell Parry.name: Quiet Bell Parry
Quiet Bell Parry.description: Tune a brief vibration through your real guard as you meet one incoming weapon or material strike. It can jar the contacting surface, but must win the physical timing and material contest rather than shattering any weapon. Costs 12 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Falling Sky Anchor.name: Falling Sky Anchor
Falling Sky Anchor.description: Increase your downward support while receiving one major close impact through a trained guard. Your real footing and the attack’s scale decide what holds; the stance can hinder your own immediate movement. Costs 14 Mana and 6 Stamina on commitment.

Folded Point.name: Folded Point
Folded Point.description: Shorten the last half-metre of one visible close weapon line through a controlled spatial fold. Resolve one trained physical attack with that limited reach; it cannot place an edge inside unseen anatomy or bypass a sealed route. Costs 14 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Nearside Bastion.name: Nearside Bastion
Nearside Bastion.description: Shift yourself and the real guard you hold up to one metre onto a directly seen safe footing while meeting one visible threat. This is one defensive relocation with a real landing, not an extra free teleport after another action. Costs 16 Mana and 6 Stamina on commitment.

Duskfang Passing Cut.name: Duskfang Passing Cut
Duskfang Passing Cut.description: Deepen the shadow along a real passing strike to make its visible edge harder to follow. The attack remains physical and reachable, without shadow teleportation, personal Mana draining or automatic counterspell. Costs 8 Mana and 4 Stamina on commitment.

Hollow Guard Catch.name: Hollow Guard Catch
Hollow Guard Catch.description: Layer a small dampening patch over your real guard where one observed magical line is about to meet it. Both the physical defence and opposed magic matter; it does not suppress the attacker’s whole discipline. Costs 12 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Steady Hands Escort.name: Steady Hands Escort
Steady Hands Escort.description: Use a trained supporting hold to move one willing injured creature a few safe steps while easing localized pain. This is an evacuation manoeuvre, with no Health restoration, repaired injury or immunity to attacks. Costs 8 Mana and 4 Stamina on commitment.

Mercy’s Narrow Window.name: Mercy’s Narrow Window
Mercy’s Narrow Window.description: Use precise trained movement to reach one willing adjacent patient through a real contested opening and apply brief direct treatment. On successful treatment restore up to 8% of their maximum Health once, rounded down; the whole action is care and positioning rather than an added attack. Round restoration down, cap it at actual maximum Health, and apply an already resolved recovery only once. Costs 12 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Runes on the Knuckles.name: Runes on the Knuckles
Runes on the Knuckles.description: Inscribe a momentary reinforcing pattern over a trained striking surface before one committed close blow. The enchantment supports that physical delivery without granting lasting strength, a second hit or unknown weapon proficiency. Costs 8 Mana and 4 Stamina on commitment.

Faithful Guard Script.name: Faithful Guard Script
Faithful Guard Script.description: Tune a temporary reinforcement into the actual shield or weapon with which you meet one incoming line. It aids one resolved defence and then fades, granting neither a permanent item bonus nor autonomous protection. Costs 12 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Courser’s Joined Turn.name: Courser’s Joined Turn
Courser’s Joined Turn.description: Coordinate one real quick manoeuvre with an already present controlled mount or familiar suited to it. Its movement and your own delivery share the actual command budget; this neither summons it for free nor adds an independent attack. Costs 8 Mana and 4 Stamina on commitment.

Guest Behind the Shield.name: Guest Behind the Shield
Guest Behind the Shield.description: Align your real guard with an already present controlled guardian to cover one immediate line together. Both participants need actual position and capability, and their shared defence consumes your command rather than granting two full turns. Costs 12 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

False Hem Draw.name: False Hem Draw
False Hem Draw.description: Overlay a brief false sleeve or weapon line on your real draw to bait a mistaken defence. The opponent can read the deception, and only the actual physical strike can injure them. Costs 8 Mana and 4 Stamina on commitment.

Double at the Door.name: Double at the Door
Double at the Door.description: Place a brief visual double beside your real guarded stance to confuse one observed approach. Choose and resolve one real defence; the image has no substance and cannot block a second independent attack. Costs 12 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Omen at the Wrist.name: Omen at the Wrist
Omen at the Wrist.description: Read an observed opponent’s immediate rhythm while committing one precise strike at a genuine opening. Their choices, feints and unknown techniques preserve uncertainty; the reading grants no guaranteed future or unavoidable hit. Costs 8 Mana and 4 Stamina on commitment.

The Shield Before the Sound.name: The Shield Before the Sound
The Shield Before the Sound.description: Anticipate one visible attack’s likely line and set your real guard to receive it. This informed defence remains contested and can fail if the opponent changes the pattern or another threat intervenes. Costs 12 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Pale Edge Greeting.name: Pale Edge Greeting
Pale Edge Greeting.description: Attune a real trained weapon or hand to contact one perceived incorporeal hostile entity during a close strike. Resolve the spiritual contact once; it calls no deceased soul and grants no life or Mana extraction. Costs 8 Mana and 4 Stamina on commitment.

Graveward Stance.name: Graveward Stance
