Graveward Stance.description: Hold a trained defensive position while anchoring a small spiritual ward over yourself and one willing adjacent ally. It contests one identified spiritual intrusion for the exchange, without animating remains or binding a conscious soul. Costs 12 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

The Seventh Counterstroke.name: The Seventh Counterstroke
The Seventh Counterstroke.description: Shape a tight plane of raw mana at an incoming physical projectile and strike it off its line. Resolve one Arcane Magic defense against the actual attack; a successful deflection does not automatically return it to its owner or erase an area blast. Costs 24 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Arcane Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

Foxfire Procession.name: Foxfire Procession
Foxfire Procession.description: Guide a small procession of floating flames along a visible route for light, a distraction or a controlled ignition. Direct each flame deliberately; they are not intelligent familiars, and scattered flames do not become several free attacks. Costs 10 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Fire Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

The River Wears Your Face.name: The River Wears Your Face
The River Wears Your Face.description: Draw nearby water into a roughly person-shaped moving decoy under direct control. Its wavering surface can confuse a brief observation, obstruct a path or absorb an impact; it has no mind, spells or independent turns. Costs 22 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Water Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

requirements.variable: Formula: The River Wears Your Face

The Mason's Last Word.name: The Mason's Last Word
The Mason's Last Word.description: Raise a short, heavy barrier from suitable real earth or stone at a visible point. Its size and thickness must fit the available material and the actual result; it does not grow inside a body or seal every possible escape. Costs 28 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Earth Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

The Hundredth Feather.name: The Hundredth Feather
The Hundredth Feather.description: Spread a cushioning updraft beneath up to three nearby falling people for a brief descent. It slows an actual fall according to control, weight and available space; it provides neither sustained flight nor an extra action. Costs 14 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Wind Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

Thunder's Second Name.name: Thunder's Second Name
Thunder's Second Name.description: Send a deliberately forked discharge toward at most two close, clearly perceived targets. Resolve the actual Lightning Magic attack and each target's protection; the fork is one working rather than an automatic second hit or guaranteed paralysis. Costs 30 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Lightning Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

Winter's Borrowed Crown.name: Winter's Borrowed Crown
Winter's Borrowed Crown.description: Form a curved crown of temporary ice plates around a nearby threatened position. Use one Ice Magic defense; the brittle plates can absorb or redirect a suitable impact before shattering, without surrounding the caster in absolute protection. Costs 24 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Ice Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

Noon Behind Closed Eyes.name: Noon Behind Closed Eyes
Noon Behind Closed Eyes.description: Release a tightly directed brilliant flash toward a visible approach. It can spoil aim or briefly overwhelm exposed vision when the contest succeeds. Closed eyes, cover and actual protection matter; the flash is not healing or a guaranteed stun. Costs 12 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Light Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

The Blacksmith's White Lie.name: The Blacksmith's White Lie
The Blacksmith's White Lie.description: Temporarily soften and reshape one small, accessible piece of real metal under controlled touch. It can bend a fitting or ease a jam with an appropriate result; complex locks, reinforced alloys and hostile resistance still need real work. Costs 20 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Metal Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

A Garden Between Heartbeats.name: A Garden Between Heartbeats
A Garden Between Heartbeats.description: Raise a brief thicket of temporary stems and thorns across a small suitable patch of ground. Use its real reach to obstruct, contain or threaten; targets can resist or force another route. It creates neither lasting food nor healing for animals or people. Costs 26 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Nature Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

The Bell That Answers Nothing.name: The Bell That Answers Nothing
The Bell That Answers Nothing.description: Dampen a small area around a visible point for a short interval, making ordinary sound difficult to carry. The effect can conceal a noise or hinder audible coordination, but does not automatically cancel silent casting or every form of magic. Costs 22 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Sound Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

requirements.variable: Formula: The Bell That Answers Nothing

Crownfall Waltz.name: Crownfall Waltz
Crownfall Waltz.description: Tilt the local pull across a small visible patch to disrupt footing or draw loose objects toward an edge. Resolve one Gravity Magic working with actual weight and resistance. It creates no black hole, inevitable fall or free sequence of attacks. Costs 30 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Gravity Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

The Seam That Holds.name: The Seam That Holds
The Seam That Holds.description: Temporarily reinforce the actual seams and fastenings of one worn garment or light piece of equipment. It supports an appropriate defense or prevents a stressed join from giving way. It is not a permanent item upgrade or an added inventory bonus. Costs 12 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Enchantment Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

Mercy's Last Stitch.name: Mercy's Last Stitch
Mercy's Last Stitch.description: Attempt a concentrated repair of appropriate fresh bodily injury in one reachable living target, restoring about 35 percent of its actual maximum Health on a full suitable success, capped by the real injury. Failed or partial work follows the result. It does not reverse aging, resurrect or cure an unrelated lasting condition. Costs 30 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Healing Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

A Guest Made of Rain.name: A Guest Made of Rain
A Guest Made of Rain.description: Call one small temporary water elemental with a simple agreed task. Its actual body, presence and actions must be established as a summon; it has no automatic attack on arrival, independent spell repertoire or permanent place in the party. Sustaining and directing it uses real attention. Costs 28 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Summoning Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

requirements.variable: Formula: A Guest Made of Rain

The Applause Behind You.name: The Applause Behind You
The Applause Behind You.description: Project a brief, localized illusion of applause and movement at a visible nearby point. It can draw attention or support a feint when believed, without compelling a target's action or creating real spectators. Costs 12 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Illusion Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

Footprint of the Unchosen Road.name: Footprint of the Unchosen Road
Footprint of the Unchosen Road.description: Seek a brief, uncertain impression of one immediate hazard or consequence along a route actually under consideration. Interpret the actual vision and evidence; it is not a map of every danger, verified testimony or control over time. Costs 24 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Divination Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

requirements.variable: Formula: Footprint of the Unchosen Road

The Hole in the Chorus.name: The Hole in the Chorus
The Hole in the Chorus.description: Direct a narrow disruptive absence into one exposed, ongoing magical effect. Contest the real working; scope and resistance govern interruption. It cannot erase every spell, a permanent artifact or the public portal network by declaration. Costs 28 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Void Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

requirements.variable: Formula: The Hole in the Chorus

The Door Within Reach.name: The Door Within Reach
The Door Within Reach.description: Attempt a displacement of no more than three meters to a clearly perceived safe point within the same immediate place. It needs the established Gravity foundation and actual Space control. Resolve the movement and destination honestly; it neither crosses realm boundaries nor supplies public portal permission. Costs 26 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Space Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

The Ferryman's Small Courtesy.name: The Ferryman's Small Courtesy
The Ferryman's Small Courtesy.description: Offer a respectful channel through which one actually present minor spirit can answer a short question or signal a preference. Its knowledge, agency and willingness remain its own. A response is not compelled truth, resurrection or contact with every dead person. Costs 16 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Soul Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

Paper Moon Phalanx.name: Paper Moon Phalanx
Paper Moon Phalanx.description: Arrange three connected planes of temporary raw-mana geometry into a moving defensive screen. They form one controlled working with real limits and openings, not three autonomous combatants. It requires sustained attention and an actual Arcane Magic defense. Costs 42 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Arcane Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

Cathedral of Cinders.name: Cathedral of Cinders
Cathedral of Cinders.description: Raise a ring of intense fire around a visible position, no more than five meters across. Control its real heat and direction through an extreme Fire Magic working; maintaining it takes attention. It does not strike everyone automatically, spare allies by assumption or create free extra turns. Costs 55 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Fire Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

Hollow-Lake Reversal.name: Hollow-Lake Reversal
Hollow-Lake Reversal.description: Gather a substantial nearby body of existing water into one controlled surge and turn it along a chosen visible course. Mass, footing, structures and resistance constrain the result. The water moves now; no event, injury or moment is rewound. Costs 48 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Water Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

Sleeping Dune Coffin.name: Sleeping Dune Coffin
Sleeping Dune Coffin.description: Drive existing loose earth or sand upward around one target's lower body to restrain movement. Resistance, footing and escape attempts matter; entombment is dangerous and is not an automatic captured or dead result. Costs 30 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Earth Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

The Uninvited Gale.name: The Uninvited Gale
The Uninvited Gale.description: Drive a sharp, shaped gust across a short visible approach, scattering unsecured objects and contesting the footing of those in its path. Its actual size and force follow the working, without automatically throwing every target or extending through solid walls. Costs 26 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Wind Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

Lighthouse in Your Hand.name: Lighthouse in Your Hand
Lighthouse in Your Hand.description: Concentrate a bright steady beam from a held point for illumination, signaling or a deliberately focused attack. Resolve its actual line, exposure and protection. Illumination supplies no hidden knowledge, healing or automatic hit. Costs 25 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Light Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

Borrowed Breath.name: Borrowed Breath
Borrowed Breath.description: Attempt urgent stabilization of a reachable living patient who can still be saved, supporting breathing and the immediate failing condition. An appropriate success restores up to 20 Health once and addresses that actual emergency. It is not resurrection, invulnerability or a cure for every poison. Costs 28 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Healing Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

One More Chore.name: One More Chore
One More Chore.description: Animate one small set of actual animal remains for a brief simple physical task. This working moves remains without calling their former conscious soul. The resulting servant needs actual placement and limited actions, and its animation ends when the task or sustaining control ends. Costs 24 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Soul Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

The Coppersmith's Pet Dragon.name: The Coppersmith's Pet Dragon
The Coppersmith's Pet Dragon.description: Shape and directly guide a small length of real wire as a jointed dragonlike tool for reaching, gripping or a precise feint. Its metal, reach and force remain finite. It has no mind, breath weapon, free independent attack or permanent familiar bond. Costs 24 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Metal Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

Invitation to an Empty Room.name: Invitation to an Empty Room
Invitation to an Empty Room.description: Lay a convincing visual and audible impression over one visible doorway or opening, suggesting an empty interior from a limited approach. Observation, touch, movement and contrary evidence can expose it. The illusion does not alter the actual room or transport anyone. Costs 24 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Illusion Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

requirements.variable: Formula: Invitation to an Empty Room

Margin Remembered.name: Margin Remembered
Margin Remembered.description: Carefully reconstruct a previously observed page, route detail or conversation relevant to the present investigation. Resolve an investigation check with this bonus; missing observations and a misleading original remain missing or misleading. Costs 4 Stamina for a committed concentrated attempt.

Before the Glass Falls.name: Before the Glass Falls
Before the Glass Falls.description: Use a sound, motion or other plausible nearby cue to notice an immediate developing hazard. Resolve Perception with this bonus. It reveals only what that cue can support and does not automatically evade an attack or identify an unseen culprit. Costs 5 Stamina.

Late Bell Sidestep.name: Late Bell Sidestep
Late Bell Sidestep.description: Commit to a quick evasive step against an actual incoming threat, using acrobatics or the existing Finesse delivery appropriate to the action. Apply this bonus to one defend resolution, not both. A supplied miss or hit remains authoritative. Costs 6 Stamina.

The Door Holds.name: The Door Holds
The Door Holds.description: Set a real guard against one approaching attack or attempt to force passage. Resolve Guarded Combat with this bonus. It protects the space you can actually cover and gives no immunity, extra attack or automatic restraint. Costs 8 Stamina.

Needle Between Beats.name: Needle Between Beats
Needle Between Beats.description: Make one precise Finesse Combat attack against an actual reachable target, using this bonus. Describe a concrete opening rather than granting another action or ignoring armor. Costs 8 Stamina.

Gatepost Reprimand.name: Gatepost Reprimand
Gatepost Reprimand.description: Commit to one powerful Force Combat strike with an actual suitable weapon or trained bodily method. This bonus improves that one resolution; there is no additional knockback or structural destruction without the actual outcome. Costs 12 Stamina.

Borrow the Balance.name: Borrow the Balance
Borrow the Balance.description: Attempt one close grapple, escape or controlled takedown through Force Combat or athletics as the actual action requires. Use the bonus once. Size, reach, footing and resistance still apply; no automatic restraint follows. Costs 8 Stamina.

One Quiet Line.name: One Quiet Line
One Quiet Line.description: Take a deliberate shot with an actual held bow, crossbow, sling or throwing weapon. Resolve the appropriate Finesse Combat attack with this bonus and spend real ammunition where applicable. No second shot or impossible line of sight. Costs 7 Stamina.

First Clean Draft.name: First Clean Draft
First Clean Draft.description: Make one actual Spellcraft design or revision attempt for a feasible working within your knowledge. Apply this bonus to the invention check. Difficult work still needs its real research and materials; a successful draft does not grant automatic mastery or a second free ability. Costs 8 Mana for a committed magical test.

Lanternjaw Spark.name: Lanternjaw Spark
Lanternjaw Spark.description: Release a compact jaw-shaped snap of fire at one nearby reachable target. Resolve Fire Magic with this bonus. It is one ordinary attack with bounded flame, not a lasting creature or automatic ignition of the surroundings. Costs 9 Mana.

Blue Needle Current.name: Blue Needle Current
Blue Needle Current.description: Direct a narrow current through available water or temporary conjured water at one reachable target. Resolve Water Magic with this bonus. A contested disarm or interruption is an alternative purpose, not extra free damage. Costs 9 Mana.

Stone Palm Courtesy.name: Stone Palm Courtesy
Stone Palm Courtesy.description: Raise or shift a small reachable section of ordinary earth into a low brace or obstacle. Resolve Earth Magic with this bonus when contested. It needs real footing or temporary conjuration and cannot collapse a building by declaration. Costs 10 Mana.

Ribbon Through the Air.name: Ribbon Through the Air
Ribbon Through the Air.description: Guide a precise gust to move one light unattended object, clear a small patch of smoke or attempt a bounded interruption. Resolve Wind Magic with this bonus if uncertain. No unrestricted flight or automatic disarm. Costs 8 Mana.

Bluebell Discharge.name: Bluebell Discharge
Bluebell Discharge.description: Send one short controlled electrical discharge at a nearby reachable target. Resolve Lightning Magic with this bonus. It gives no automatic stun, extra chain attack or safe passage through unrelated conductors. Costs 10 Mana.

Winter's Fine Signature.name: Winter's Fine Signature
Winter's Fine Signature.description: Form a thin bounded frost pattern on one nearby surface or attempt one small ice attack. Resolve Ice Magic with this bonus. Freezing an entire person, room or body of water is outside its scope. Costs 10 Mana.

Single Star Aperture.name: Single Star Aperture

Shrine-Step Uprising.name: Shrine-Step Uprising
Shrine-Step Uprising.description: Raise one short ridge of available earth to interrupt a lane or give low cover. Costs 8 Mana on commitment, including a failed attempt. The bonus applies to this single action.

Mountain's Folded Hand.name: Mountain's Folded Hand
Mountain's Folded Hand.description: Close a limited earthen barrier around an actual position, leaving escape and structural consequences relevant. Costs 16 Mana on commitment, including a failed attempt. The bonus applies to this single action.

Green Ribbon Breeze.name: Green Ribbon Breeze
Green Ribbon Breeze.description: Guide a small translucent curl of air around a light object or a short exposed flame. Costs 4 Mana on commitment, including a failed attempt. The bonus applies to this single action.

Swallow past the Eaves.name: Swallow past the Eaves
Swallow past the Eaves.description: Use one brief gust to aid a committed lateral movement; it is not sustained flight. Costs 8 Mana on commitment, including a failed attempt. The bonus applies to this single action.

Thousand Leaves Passing.name: Thousand Leaves Passing
Thousand Leaves Passing.description: Send a broad curling gust through one lane, disturbing aim and loose footing. Costs 16 Mana on commitment, including a failed attempt. The bonus applies to this single action.

Thunder under Silk.name: Thunder under Silk
Thunder under Silk.description: Release one short branching discharge toward a reachable conductor or target. Costs 6 Mana on commitment, including a failed attempt. The bonus applies to this single action.

Storm-Drum Crack.name: Storm-Drum Crack
Storm-Drum Crack.description: Commit one forceful lightning strike with a visible line and real risk to nearby conductors. Costs 12 Mana on commitment, including a failed attempt. The bonus applies to this single action.

Winter Plum Mark.name: Winter Plum Mark
Winter Plum Mark.description: Form a small temporary ice mark that cools or makes one defined contact surface slick. Costs 6 Mana on commitment, including a failed attempt. The bonus applies to this single action.

White Branch Lattice.name: White Branch Lattice
White Branch Lattice.description: Grow a brittle temporary ice obstruction with actual gaps, anchors and melting limits. Costs 14 Mana on commitment, including a failed attempt. The bonus applies to this single action.

Lantern on the Water.name: Lantern on the Water
Lantern on the Water.description: Place a small floating light near the caster, illuminating a useful area without healing anyone. Costs 4 Mana on commitment, including a failed attempt. The bonus applies to this single action.

Dawn through the Screen.name: Dawn through the Screen
Dawn through the Screen.description: Project one concentrated beam through an actual open line. Costs 12 Mana on commitment, including a failed attempt. The bonus applies to this single action.

Iron Petal Turn.name: Iron Petal Turn
Iron Petal Turn.description: Turn or stabilize a small reachable metal piece without controlling an entire weapon collection. Costs 6 Mana on commitment, including a failed attempt. The bonus applies to this single action.

Folded Steel Oath.name: Folded Steel Oath
Folded Steel Oath.description: Reinforce one real blade through a committed action; the metal and learned weapon method still matter. Costs 14 Mana on commitment, including a failed attempt. The bonus applies to this single action.

Root Bow of Welcome.name: Root Bow of Welcome
Root Bow of Welcome.description: Guide a real pliant root or stem into a useful short curve without healing a creature. Costs 4 Mana on commitment, including a failed attempt. The bonus applies to this single action.

Wisteria Gate.name: Wisteria Gate
Wisteria Gate.description: Raise temporary plant growth across a limited opening; solid ground and fire remain relevant. Costs 12 Mana on commitment, including a failed attempt. The bonus applies to this single action.

Bell over Still Water.name: Bell over Still Water
Bell over Still Water.description: Send one tuned vibration that tests a small material or interrupts fragile concentration. Costs 6 Mana on commitment, including a failed attempt. The bonus applies to this single action.

Drumbeat without Echo.name: Drumbeat without Echo
Drumbeat without Echo.description: Release one directional sound pulse to spoil timing; allies in its line are not automatically exempt. Costs 14 Mana on commitment, including a failed attempt. The bonus applies to this single action.

Ancestor's Threshold.name: Ancestor's Threshold
Ancestor's Threshold.description: Tend a narrow spiritual boundary and contest one weak intrusive manifestation. Costs 6 Mana on commitment, including a failed attempt. The bonus applies to this single action.

White Sleeve Parting.name: White Sleeve Parting
White Sleeve Parting.description: Separate a hostile spirit's immediate hold through a real contested working, without commanding its entire soul. Costs 12 Mana on commitment, including a failed attempt. The bonus applies to this single action.

Borrowed Festival Frame.name: Borrowed Festival Frame
Borrowed Festival Frame.description: Animate one prepared empty frame for a short task using residual mana rather than a deceased conscious person. Costs 16 Mana on commitment, including a failed attempt. The bonus applies to this single action.

Fox behind the Lantern.name: Fox behind the Lantern
Fox behind the Lantern.description: Place a limited false silhouette within a real sightline; touch and inconsistent behavior can reveal it. Costs 6 Mana on commitment, including a failed attempt. The bonus applies to this single action.

Rain on an Empty Sleeve.name: Rain on an Empty Sleeve
Rain on an Empty Sleeve.description: Sustain a convincing moving decoy in one area while concentration and actual movement remain distinct. Costs 14 Mana on commitment, including a failed attempt. The bonus applies to this single action.

Ink between the Leaves.name: Ink between the Leaves
Ink between the Leaves.description: Create a small absence that contests one fragile spell edge rather than deleting all nearby magic. Costs 12 Mana on commitment, including a failed attempt. The bonus applies to this single action.

Petalweight Landing.name: Petalweight Landing
Petalweight Landing.description: Reduce the strain of one prepared descent over a short distance; no unrestricted flight or portal follows. Costs 10 Mana on commitment, including a failed attempt. The bonus applies to this single action.

Hold the Turning Joint.name: Hold the Turning Joint
Hold the Turning Joint.description: Brace and isolate an actual mechanism's loaded joint for inspection without granting a free repair. Costs 4 Stamina on commitment, including a failed attempt. The bonus applies to this single action.

One Honest Charge.name: One Honest Charge
One Honest Charge.description: Test a real crystal feed through a controlled cycle, identifying an observable fault or safe operating limit. Costs 5 Stamina on commitment, including a failed attempt. The bonus applies to this single action.

Crossbow's Patient Return.name: Crossbow's Patient Return
Crossbow's Patient Return.description: Clear a plausible feed obstruction and reset a loaded mechanism using real tools and time. Costs 7 Stamina on commitment, including a failed attempt. The bonus applies to this single action.

Cooling Sparrow Cycle.name: Cooling Sparrow Cycle
Cooling Sparrow Cycle.description: Vent an actual overheated device through a prepared cycle; charge, material damage and safe positioning remain relevant. Costs 9 Stamina on commitment, including a failed attempt. The bonus applies to this single action.
